8250489.en: Her delicate fingers tap in rhythm with "destiny", and thunder rolls once more. Two cultivators struggle against the lightning when suddenly, items begin flying out of their Interspatial Rings one by one. Their faces darken as they cough blood, and they desperately form a seal to break free with a burst of Qi before fleeing in panic, their curses of witch and dark arts fading into the distance...
8250489.ch: 青葱玉指随着“福缘深厚”连点了四下，天空又一轰隆声响起。两名修士在电光中苦苦支撑，忽见自身储物戒中的物品一个一个飞出，倏得脸色一黑，吐血掐诀狠的凝气一爆，忙不迭窜逃而去，嘴边模糊喊着“妖妇”“妖术”云云......

8250490.en: Sigh. I understand now... This was my burden to bear from the start. I should have dealt with it myself.
8250490.ch: 唉，我知道了……这本是我自己的事，应该由我自己来料理的。

8250491.en: {name|B} is deeply disappointed. She gracefully extends her arms and rises into the air. Her silhouette streaks across the horizon like a comet, vanishing in the blink of an eye.
8250491.ch: {name|B}大为失望，当下手臂轻舒，腾上半空，只见天边黛影去如飞彗，眨眼就不见了。

8250492.en: Hmph, how rude of them to throw around words like that, don't you think? *giggles* I picked up these little trinkets for you along the way. I need to get going now, but I look forward to our next meeting!
8250492.ch: 哼，他们满嘴“妖”什么的说人家真没礼貌是不是？呵呵，这些东西顺手给你拿的，姐姐先行一步，期待你再来找我噢。

8250493.en: {name|B} gracefully extends her arms and rises into the air. Her silhouette streaks across the horizon like a comet, vanishing in the blink of an eye.
8250493.ch: {name|B}当下手臂轻舒，腾上半空，只见天边黛影去如飞彗，眨眼就不见了。

8250494.en: You arrive at {name|B}'s residence, but the familiar sight of her reading in her bamboo study is gone—along with her entire book collection, which has been thoroughly ransacked. Suddenly, your senses tingle as the wind carries whispered words to your ears.
8250494.ch: 你来到{name|B}住处，然而一向爱在竹庐读书的人早已不见，周围藏书亦被搜索一空。此时你灵机震动，只觉随风送来悠悠语声。

8250495.en: I was one step too late. I received a mysterious bounty to capture that woman, but when I arrived, she was already gone.
8250495.ch: 来慢了一步，我受到神秘悬赏要抓住那个女子，没想到来到时候人已不见了。

8250496.en: I arrived just in time to see them capture her. It took six or seven cultivators surrounding her before they finally managed to subdue and take her away with grievous wounds.
8250496.ch: 我来的时候恰恰看到他们拿住了她。六七名修士围攻那女子，这才将她打成重伤拿走了。

8250497.en: I heard she was incredibly powerful back in the day, so I even brought a treasure with me just in case. What a shame—someone else reaped all the rewards.
8250497.ch: 听说那女子昔日非常厉害，这次我还带了秘宝前来，以备不测。可惜，功劳却被人旁人捞走了。

8250498.en: Let's go. Four of the attacking cultivators were wounded, and she left another one clinging to their Last Breath.
8250498.ch: 走吧，围攻的修士也伤了四个，还有一人被那女修打得仅剩一丝元魂。

8250499.en: As you listen to their conversation, the two figures gradually walk away, their voices carried on the wind, growing fainter until they fade into silence.
8250499.ch: 你正听他们说话，没料二人逐渐远去，随风而来的语声也慢慢消失。

8250500.en: Hey there! Have you been missing me? It's been a while since I've stirred up any trouble—my fingers are getting itchy! Here, take these and hone your skills. When the time comes, we'll teach those bad guys a lesson together!
8250500.ch: 喂，最近有没有想念姐姐？感觉有一段时间没有去惹是生非了，真想舒展舒展手脚，你拿着这些，练好本事，以后有机会，咱们去教训坏人。

8250504.en: You don't want to know? Well, I'm telling you anyway! My name is {name|B}. Oh, and don't forget—even without me around to keep an eye on you, you better keep up with your studies, got it? Haha!
8250504.ch: 你不想知道，可我偏要告诉你。姐姐叫{name|B}。对了，没了我监督也要好好学习，知道了吗？哈哈。

8250505.en:
As other flowers wither and fade away, you alone bloom splendidly in the garden's sway. Shadows dance across clear waters, sparse and light, while subtle fragrance drifts in the moonlit night.
Frost-touched birds pause, stealing glances below; butterflies would lose their souls if they knew. Your gentle whispers are company enough for me, and there is no need for wine or song to set my spirit free.
8250505.ch:
众芳摇落独暄妍，占尽风情向小园。疏影横斜水清浅，暗香浮动月黄昏。
霜禽欲下先偷眼，粉蝶如知合断魂。幸有微吟可相狎，不须檀板共金樽。

8250507.en: Hmm, do you know who penned these verses...
8250507.ch: 呵呵，你可知这首诗出自何人之手......

8250509.en: Hehe, I would never deliberately put you in harm's way.
8250509.ch: 嘿嘿，姐姐可不是故意让你陷入危险之中的。

8250510.en: An upstanding person should face their challenges head-on, and I will make sure you bravely face everything that comes your way!
8250510.ch: 一个正直的人就应该直面困难，姐姐会让你勇敢地面对一切的。

8250511.en: {name|B} smiles faintly and tilts her head to look at you, her piercing gaze seeming to probe deep into your thoughts.
8250511.ch: {name|B}微微一笑偏过头来看着你，那眼神十分锐利，仿佛要审视你心底真意一般。

8250512.en: Heh, you're a good girl. Very good indeed. If you have any manuals you're working on, come by my place. I can help you understand them better.
8250512.ch: 呵呵，小妹妹还是个好人，不错不错。有什么秘籍不妨来我的住处，我可以指点一二，让你更快将所学融会贯通。

8250513.en: {name|B} pushes a tiny package into your hands.
8250513.ch: {name|B}伸手给你塞来一个小小包裹。

8250514.en: Before you can make sense of what's happening, {name|B} is already standing far away.
8250514.ch: 你还要搞明白怎么回事，{name|B}却已重新远远的站了开去。

8250515.en: I've figured out everything that happened after I got trapped, and the seal on me has been broken.
8250515.ch: 我遭困后的一切来龙去脉都已经搞清楚了，自己身上的封印也解除了。

8250516.en: But there are still things I need to figure out. It won't be easy, but I must keep searching. If you have any questions about the manuals, come find me. I will be happy to help.
8250516.ch: 但有些事，我还是想要弄明白。可能会很艰难，但我必须追寻下去。如果秘籍上有什么疑难不妨来此找我，姐姐定会给你指点一二的。

8250517.en: {name|B} waves goodbye and disappears. Where is she going? She is still somewhere in this world, exploring its far-flung corners. Maybe, if fate allows, your paths will cross again soon.
8250517.ch: {name|B}朝你挥了挥手，然后逐渐去远。她会去哪呢？所幸苍天所及，土地所覆，都不过八荒之内，若是机缘到了，也许你们之间很快就又会再次邂逅。

8250518.en: Back then, she seemed to be working against me, but she was actually protecting me all along. But she was too proud, and circumstances prevented her from telling me directly. That's why she hid the riddle in the fan. Once I truly understand her intentions, I won't hold anything against her anymore—and there'll be no need to keep me bound.
8250518.ch: 她当年看似要对付我，实则却是在保护我。但这家伙终究太过骄傲，又囿于情势，不能说破。因此将这谜语放在扇子之中。如果有朝一日我能体会她的深意，我就不会再跟她为难，那是也没必要困住我了。

8250519.en: We were surrounded by monsters, and in that desperate moment, all I wanted was to protect my dear sister—you. My feelings resonated with her past intentions, breaking the fan's seal and unleashing its power. That's how we managed to escape with our lives.
8250519.ch: 当时我们遭妖兽围困，千钧一发，我想要设法保护我的小姐妹，也就是你，此番心情与她当时的心意暗中契合，折扇封印解开，显出异能，这才让你我避过一劫。

8252001.en: Greetings, fellow cultivator. My name's Xiang Laichi. Please bear with me. Recently, I've been tracking a mythical beast in Yong Ning. Have you seen any sign of it?
8252001.ch: 道友好，在下向来痴。近日我正追捕永宁州中的大妖兽，敢问阁下可知此妖踪迹？

8252002.en: The person produces an old, worn scroll. With a flick of his wrist, a portrait appears on its surface.
8252002.ch: 面前之人拿出一张残破老旧的画卷。他将画卷展开，然后用手一划，上面竟显出一张肖像。

8252003.ch: 敢问阁下，见过这只妖兽吗？

8252004.en: Oh, my mistake! This is the right one.
8252004.ch: 咦！不好意思，弄错了！这个才是！

8252005.en: The man smiles sheepishly and changes the portrait. The new image, though still rough, clearly depicts an arachnid monster...
8252005.ch: 此人不好意思的笑笑，这才划手换了一幅画像。此次画中之物仍如涂鸦，但可想见乃是一只蜘蛛之妖……

8252006.en: Well? Have you seen this one?

8252007.en: I'm incredibly grateful! I'll go search right away. It was fate that brought us together. Please accept this small token of my appreciation. If you hear anything about the monster, please let me know!
8252007.ch: 感激不尽！我这便去寻！与道友相见也是缘分，这是一点心意，请您收下。到时若知道妖兽的行踪还请相告！

8252008.en: Very well then! I'll keep searching elsewhere. It was fate that brought us together. Please accept this small token of my appreciation. If you hear anything about the monster, please let me know!
8252008.ch: 也罢！那我继续去寻便是。与道友相见也是缘分，这是一点心意，请您收下。到时若知道妖兽的行踪还请相告！

8252009.en: A woman stands atop a hill. With a graceful gesture, she sends a silken ribbon fluttering down like a waterfall. It catches a small fish and drops it into a nearby pond. The fish, gasping for air, is returned to its watery home, its life slowly returning.
8252009.ch: 只见一名女子驻足丘上，她一招手，一条丝织布带如瀑甩出缠住一尾小鱼甩到水潭之中。那鱼儿原在干地，奄奄欲毙，这下重入水泽，这才生机渐复。

8252010.ch: 天地有序，各安其位，小鱼儿，你就这么想不开吗？

8252011.en: I laugh at this fish's foolish ambition. It ventured beyond its natural home. But a fish is a fish. It's meant to live in water. No matter how tempting the outside world may be, what business does it have there?
8252011.ch: 我笑这鱼儿不自量力，离水探索。然则鱼终究是鱼，它只能在水里活着，外面再是新奇，又与它何干？

8252012.en: Oh? So you think this fish, by breaking the rules, could change the world? Indeed, great changes often start small.
8252012.ch: 哦？阁下似乎是说，这鱼儿偏离常规，但亦因此造就天地不同？诚然，天下间的变化都是一点一滴而来的。

8252013.en: With a graceful wave of her hand, the beautiful woman unexpectedly flings the fish back onto dry land. This time, the creature flops a few times and dies.
8252013.ch: 面前丽人挥手间，竟又将那鱼儿再摔到旱地之中，不过此次它只跳动几下便没动静了。

8252014.en: It seems this fish has failed to live up to your expectations. By staying out of its element, it overreached. Everyone claims to be unique, but in the end, we're all just part of the crowd.
8252014.ch: 看来，这鱼儿有负阁下期待。待在不该自己待的地方，终究不自量力，人人自诩与众不同，却总是庸众之一，并无例外。

8252015.en: Alas, most people in this world are just like this fish.
8252015.ch: 可惜，这世上的人都和这鱼儿差不多。

8252016.en: I have other things to do. Farewell.

8252017.en: The woman offers a knowing smile and walks away. Her expression is inscrutable, a blend of indifference and something deeper. Who is she, really?
8252017.ch: 面前女子朝你笑笑，转身而去。她的笑容之中，有得几分超然，又有几分难以言明的意味，此人究竟是谁？

8252018.en: You spot <ta4>, the mysterious woman, nearby.
8252018.ch: 只见那名神秘女子天香正在站在不远处。

8252019.en: What's the problem? Am I not allowed to be here? Of course you wouldn't know about me, you're always with Miss Ao.
8252019.ch: 如何？我不能在这的吗？你跟那位敖姑娘终日混在一起，当然不知道我的存在了。

8252020.en: Such a darling little thing, but she's got a sharp edge.
8252020.ch: 顶可爱的一个小姑娘，可惜喜欢作死。

8252021.en: They say it's a dragon scale. I just picked it up to take a look. What's the big deal?
8252021.ch: 据说是龙族的鳞片。我捡了拿来看看，怎么？

8252022.en: Purpose? I don't like that word. I have things to do, but I'm not in a hurry. It's different from what you call a "purpose," isn't it?
8252022.ch: 目的？我不喜欢目的这个说法。我有要做的事，但我并不急切。这跟你们说的目的不一样，不是吗？

8252023.en: What's going on? Is Miss Ao in trouble?
8252023.ch: 怎么？那位敖姑娘遇到什么困难了吗？

8252024.en: Ah, her. Wouldn't it have been better if she'd just stayed in her place? But no, she had to go somewhere she didn't belong.
8252024.ch: 她啊，好好的待在自己应该待的地方不就好了吗？偏要来到不属于自己的地方。

8252025.en: Ao Yao is naturally curious, always eager to explore the unknown. Little does she know the high price of curiosity.
8252025.ch: 敖瑶生性好奇，对于探索未知抱有热心，殊不知好奇的代价却十分昂贵。

8252026.en: I understand everyone is different, but fundamentally, we're all the same. You, me, the cultivators of this world—aren't we all cut from the same cloth?
8252026.ch: 我承认每个人存在区别，但整体来说，我们都是差不多的。你、我，八荒修士，不都这样？

8252027.en: That's a question for you to ponder. Life, death, love, loss—these may seem like choices you make now. But from another perspective, aren't these outcomes already written?
8252027.ch: 那该问你自己。或生或死，或聚或散，可能和你当下做的决定有关，但我们换个角度看，这些后果何尝不是早已有了自己的因缘？

8252028.en: Helping Ao Yao might not lead to a happy ending. Similarly, walking away doesn't mean she's doomed.
8252028.ch: 你帮助敖瑶，未必能有什么好结果。你就此放手，敖瑶也不见得就要落得个不好的收场。

8252029.en: The universe is a complex web. Cause and effect are intertwined. Instead of worrying about the outcome, just follow your heart.
8252029.ch: 这宇宙盘根错节，太过复杂，一切因果早有定数，与其去顾及，倒不如想做就做。

8252030.en: I have other things to do. Let's part ways.
8252030.ch: 我还有事，这就别过了吧。

8252031.en: Atop a distant hill, a beautiful woman stands tall, her gaze sweeping across the mountain peaks.
8252031.ch: 远处山丘上，一名美丽的女子正居高临下，观看四方山巅。

8252032.en: She watches the rise and fall of the sun and moon, the ebb and flow of yin and yang.
8252032.ch: 观日月盈亏，感阴阳变化。

8252033.en: Well? Ao Yao's gone now, hasn't she? How do you feel about that?
8252033.ch: 如何？敖瑶最后还是离开了吧？你有何感觉？

8252034.en: Ao Yao has left her friends behind in this world. It's hard to imagine she's happy about it.
8252034.ch: 敖瑶离开了八荒的好朋友，不见得就能很高兴。

8252035.en: Don't you feel a little sad to see her go? Or as a cultivator, have you already let go of all emotions?
8252035.ch: 难道你对她就没有半分不舍吗？还是说，作为一名修士，早已忘情弃爱了呢？

8252036.en: She's returned to where she belongs. Why be sad?
8252036.ch: 她回到原本属于自己的地方，这有什么值得难过的？

8252037.en: Indeed. She was just passing through. What's there to mourn?
8252037.ch: 也是，终究只是一个过客罢了，有什么值得留恋呢？

8252038.en: The Ao Yao thing is over. There's nothing more to see here. I'll be going now.
8252038.ch: 敖瑶的事已经告一段落，这边也没什么有意思的东西了，就此别过。

8252039.en: I'm just fascinated by Ao Yao. What will happen to such an extraordinary person? I'm curious, that's all.
8252039.ch: 我不过是觉得敖瑶十分特别，然则特别的人又会落得一个怎么样的下场呢？我仅仅是对此抱有趣味罢了。

8252040.en: Don't even think about running away this time!

8252041.en: The cultivator unrolls the scroll. A surge of power erupts from it, weaving a web of energy and summoning an arachnid monster.
8252041.ch: 那名修士扬开手中画卷，突然间一股力量溢出，无数力量交织成网，形成一片光晕。光华交织处一只蜘蛛妖现身显形。

8252042.en: Thanks for your help, fellow cultivator. Unfortunately, the monster escaped!
8252042.ch: 多谢道友帮助，可惜还是被这妖怪跑了！

8252043.en: Indeed, I spent countless hours mastering the art of capturing shadows and forms. Only through tireless effort did I manage to keep up with that monster!
8252043.ch: 是，费了我无数心思，画影图形，这才勉强追上的妖物！

8252044.en: What nonsense are you talking? It's incredibly lifelike! I studied under a master painter to learn this skill. That's why it's so good!
8252044.ch: 你胡说什么！明明就是惟妙惟肖！告诉你！我还特意跟精于此道者学了丹青之术，这才画得这么好的！

8252045.en: If it weren't for this scroll, which stopped the arachnid monster in its tracks, we wouldn't have a chance against this fiend at our current power level!
8252045.ch: 要不是有这画卷，这才让这蜘蛛精停下了脚步，否则以咱们实力，可万万别想留着这妖物呢！

8252046.en: Ugh! Crap! What a missed opportunity!
8252046.ch: 唉！可恨可恨！明明有这么好的机会！

8252047.en: Harm? Hurting people? Well... the monster hasn't actually hurt anyone yet. But prevention is key! We must stop any potential threat!
8252047.ch: 害、害人？唔……这妖倒是没害人，不错，防范于未然！我们要防范于未然！

8252048.en: I'll find a way to catch up with that monster.

8252049.en: No more talk! I must chase after the arachnid monster! If I wait any longer, I'll lose it!
8252049.ch: 不说了，我得赶紧追上这蜘蛛精！不然可跟不上了！

8252050.en: A stunning woman stands apart, her expression grim. It's clear something has upset her.
8252050.ch: 一名丽人傲立前方，其时她看着远处，一脸冷然的，似乎遇到什么不顺之事。

8252051.en: That pesky cultivator may not be skilled, but the creep's annoying as hell.
8252051.ch: 阴魂不散的家伙，手上本事不高，缠住人的本事却大大的好。

8252052.en: Hmph! I'm being followed by an annoying cultivator. This person's clinging to me like a leech, driving me crazy.
8252052.ch: 哼，我遭到烦人的修士追逐，这人阴魂不散的缠着我，叫我十分烦恼。

8252053.en: Hmph! It's a long story, and it's not important. Let's drop it.
8252053.ch: 哼，不过一些无聊的原因，不说也罢。

8252054.en: Because I've stumbled upon something quite interesting here.
8252054.ch: 因为我在这边发现了有趣的事啊。

8252055.en: As <ta4> speaks, she gives you a quick, knowing look.
8252055.ch: 天香说着，用别有意味的眼光略略打量了你一下。

8252056.en: Farewell, my friend. Stay safe. This world is full of treachery, especially from those who think they know everything.
8252056.ch: 朋友，我走了，一切还需小心在意。八荒之中，人心险恶，尤其是那些遍阅群书，见识高超的家伙。

8252057.en: <ta4> offers a small smile and walks away with measured steps.
8252057.ch: 天香向你微微一笑算是致意，这才别过身去，慢步离开。

8252058.en: <ta4> sits on a stone slab, lost in thought. She seems to be pondering a complex problem.
8252058.ch: 天香端坐一方石上，她低头凝思，似乎正在思索什么难题。

8252059.en: Fascinating. I underestimated this young woman.
8252059.ch: 有意思，我倒低估了这姑娘了。

8252060.en: I had a debate with a female cultivator. She was quite intriguing.
8252060.ch: 我与一名女修论道，此人十分有趣呢。

8252061.en: Win or lose? We weren't competing. We were simply exchanging ideas.
8252061.ch: 胜负？我们没有分胜负。其实当时的情形更像是我们在互相就一些事物交换一下看法罢了。

8252062.en: The female cultivator was impressed by my insights, but I learned a lot from her perspective as well.
8252062.ch: 那名女修固然因我的说法而万分震惊，不过我也从她的见解里得到不少裨益。

8252063.en: Seeing such a beautiful and intelligent soul in trouble, I couldn't help but want to help her.
8252063.ch: 这样的可人儿受困了，我也忍不住想要给她拉一把手呢。

8252064.en: Indeed. She's not just a pretty face; she's got a brilliant mind.
8252064.ch: 不错。先不说她原本姿色已是美丽脱俗，更难得的是那个美丽的小脑袋里还藏着那么叫人吃惊的想法。

8252065.en: Help her? She's perfectly capable. Why should I get involved?
8252065.ch: 拉把手？她这样的人，自然有自己的办法。我又何必多作干预？

8252066.en: Besides, I don't want to be caught up in whatever mess she gets herself into. I'd rather watch from the sidelines.
8252066.ch: 况且我可不想她落得个什么不好得收场却还与和我有关呢。我倒宁可在一边静静得看着较好。

8252067.en: To see her fail, to watch her spiral into despair, to witness her helplessness as the truth dawns on her... Heh.
8252067.ch: 看着她失败，看着她慢慢绝望，看着她洞悉背后真相后得无奈……呵呵。

8252068.en: If you want to play the hero, go ahead. Just don't drag me into your drama.
8252068.ch: 你爱怜香惜玉，你尽管去。不要把我也拉进去。

8252069.en: But how can you be sure helping her is the right thing to do? Sometimes, ignorance is bliss.
8252069.ch: 不过你怎知道你给人拉一把手就是好的呢？有时候有些东西还不知道的好。

8252070.en: Tch, this guy just won't give up. One of these days, I'll lose my patience and crush him.
8252070.ch: 啧，这家伙还真不叫人安生，哪天我不耐烦了，一把就将他掐成肉渣滓。

8252071.en: As <ta4> speaks, she sighs and walks away. A male cultivator bursts onto the scene.
8252071.ch: 天香说着幽幽一叹，轻轻一转身，已翩然去远，也是此时一名修士追了上来。

8252072.en: Where is she? She was just here! Have you seen her?
8252072.ch: 人呢？明明在这。朋友，你看见她了吗？

8252073.en: The man looks around frantically and pulls out an old, yellowed scroll. He shows you the contents.
8252073.ch: 面前男子左右张望一下，这才从怀中掏出一个又黄又旧的画卷，然后展开让你看里面内容。

8252074.en: Her! Did you see her? Where is she?

8252075.en: Ridiculous! My masterful brushwork perfectly captured her likeness. How could you not recognize her?
8252075.ch: 糊涂！我这妙笔之下，将她面向描绘得惟妙惟肖，还看不懂！

8252076.en: Oh, never mind. She's just a cold, arrogant woman.
8252076.ch: 唉，反正就是一个看着冷冷得，说话很高傲的姑娘。

8252077.en: Ah! I must hurry after her, or I'll lose her. Farewell! Here, take this as a token of my appreciation.
8252077.ch: 嗯！我得赶紧追上了，否则失了踪迹，又得大费周章。再见！这些小小礼物！

8252079.en: So be it. Tracking her was never going to be easy.
8252079.ch: 罢了，要想追踪她，本来就不是那么容易。

8252080.en: I... I was supposed to be looking for the arachnid monster, wasn't I? This w-woman might know where the monster is!
8252080.ch: 我……我不是要找那蜘蛛妖吗？这位女、女修可能知道蜘蛛大妖的下落呢！

8252081.en: Geez, I must hurry and catch up with her, or I'll lose her again! Farewell!
8252081.ch: 唉，我得赶紧追上那人，不然又要跟丢了！再见，道友！

8252082.en: With that, the man hastily bids you farewell. He glances around before taking off in the direction <ta4> went.
8252082.ch: 此人说着，匆匆忙忙地朝你别过。他左右眺望一下，最后朝着天香离开的方向迅速地跑去了。

8252083.en: <ta4> sits gracefully on a tree branch, reading a book. Her legs dangle idly, exuding an air of casual elegance.
8252083.ch: 天香正在一棵树杈上优雅的坐着，她手中捧着一本书，双腿来回荡着，显得十分闲雅。

8252084.en: I thought these authors were ordinary people, but this book contains deep insights.
8252084.ch: 原想这两人也不过是个俗人，却没想到书中却有不少卓见。

8252085.en: Fellow cultivator, that woman is quite extraordinary, don't you think?
8252085.ch: 道友，那名女子，不简单吧？

8252086.en: I wonder what will happen to her. Will she escape the book, or will she fade away in that world of words?
8252086.ch: 我对她的命运很感兴趣，我很想知道她最后是成功从书中摆脱困境，还是永沦书海，神识慢慢散去。

8252087.en: But her current situation isn't so bad.
8252087.ch: 不过眼下结果，也没什么不好的。

8252088.en: Watching her? Hardly. You've just been there at the right moments. If I were really watching her, you'd know by now, wouldn't you?
8252088.ch: 监视？算不上吧。只要在重要的时候，你都陪在她身边。我要监视，你早就察觉了，对吧？

8252089.en: I'm... curious. I just want to see if things turn out like I thought they would.
8252089.ch: 我，更像是感兴趣，我想看看她的命运，和我猜的是不是一样。

8252090.en: She's always been obsessed with uncovering secrets. But now that she's starting to see the truth, things aren't going as she planned.
8252090.ch: 她一直想要搞明白一切的秘密。可惜当她搞清楚一些事情以后就发现情况已不是向着自己想象的方向发展了。

8252091.en: If she knew everything, would she regret it? Sometimes, knowledge isn't always a good thing.
8252091.ch: 最后若是洞明一切，她会不会后悔呢？你看，即使聪明睿智，也没什么好的。

8252092.en: Well, I admit, she's a bit like me. I'm intrigued by her. But ultimately, we're very different.
8252092.ch: 呵呵，我承认她有些地方和我颇为相似，她某些特质也吸引了我的注意。但她和我终究是截然不同的。

8252093.en: Yes. She studied countless books, searching for answers. But when she found them, they weren't what she expected.
8252093.ch: 是啊。她遍阅群书，想要找到心中的答案，然而答案找到了，却和自己想象的大相径庭。

8252094.en: She was consumed by revenge, only to discover that her enemy wasn't so evil after all. That's a pretty unsettling realization.
8252094.ch: 她一心报复，却发现仇人对她也不尽是恶意。这结果，多少叫人心里不舒服。

8252095.en: She did what she thought was right, but it didn't turn out the way she wanted. Maybe she should've just left things alone.
8252095.ch: 她做了要做的事，得到的结果，却不是自己想要的。某程度上来说，还不如像一开始那样就算了。

8252096.en: Didn't I tell you? I'm just curious to see how her story ends. Will she fail in her revenge and wither away? Or will she uncover all the secrets and find true happiness?
8252096.ch: 我难道没说？我不过是想看看她最后会是个什么样的结局罢了。她报不了仇，会不会郁郁而终，她搞明白了一切会不会真的开心？

8252098.en: It's fascinating to watch her journey unfold. No matter what happens, it feels like everything is predetermined.
8252098.ch: 看着她慢慢走向自己的命运真的非常有意思呢。好也罢，坏也罢，一切仿佛冥冥之中，早有定数。

8252099.en: I made you a little something to play with.
8252099.ch: 闲来无事织了个小玩意，给你玩玩。

8252100.en: This is a cursed mark. Whoever wears it will have a terrible fate.
8252100.ch: 这是诅咒的标记，佩戴者命途多舛，自此不得善终。

8252101.en: Let me rephrase that. This item was always meant to be yours. I'm just the messenger.
8252101.ch: 可以换个说法。这个东西可能最终都会去到你手中，只是恰好当下借由我手交给了你。

8252102.en: It was fate that brought this item to you. As for me, I'm just bored and making things up.
8252102.ch: 可以说，是命运要将此物交给你。至于我的主观原因，我单纯无聊编着玩。

8252103.en: You're actually taking it? No second thoughts?

8252104.en: There's nothing left here for me. Farewell.
8252104.ch: 这边也没什么值得多看了，就此别过。

8252105.en: With that, <ta4> turns and walks away, ignoring you.
8252105.ch: 天香说完，也没理你，只管自己转身离去了。

8252106.en: A massive blast erupts ahead, sending a cloud of dust billowing into the air. Through the haze, you see a cultivator lying on the ground. Further in the distance, a shadowy monster lurks menacingly.
8252106.ch: 前方发生灵爆，一股尘埃四散开来，朦胧之中，可见一名修士跌坐地上，更深处似有什么妖物的影子暗暗抖动。

8252107.en: As the dust settles, you witness a horrific scene: an arachnid monster devouring a cultivator whole. The terrified cultivator struggles, but it's no use.
8252107.ch: 你仔细看去，只见尘埃飘荡之处，一名修士被前方蜘蛛妖狠狠咬住。那修士还待挣扎，未料蜘蛛巨口咬合，将之整个吞了。

8252108.en: The male cultivator on the ground watches in horror as the arachnid monster turns its attention to him. It lets out a blood-curdling screech, preparing to strike...
8252108.ch: 那跌坐地上的男修见此情状，面色发青，蜘蛛妖见状转过头朝那修士发出一声震啸，眼看就要对其不利……

8252109.en: What... What are you... going to do?

8252110.en: You step in front of the cultivator, shielding him from the attack. The arachnid monster roars and lunges at you.
8252110.ch: 你拦在那修士面前，那蜘蛛妖大吼一声朝你攻来。

8252111.en: The arachnid monster seems wary of you. After a brief fight, it retreats.
8252111.ch: 那蜘蛛妖似乎对你颇为忌惮，只与你匆匆一交手便即离开了。

8252112.en: It's... gone? I... I thought I was a goner...
8252112.ch: 走……走了？我……我以为这回死定了呢……

8252113.en: Yes... I've been hunting this monster for a while...

8252114.en: Because... because... it's a long story.
8252114.ch: 因为……因为……这中间的道理，不足为外人道！

8252115.en: Six-Eyed Bright Pupil... She's the Six-Eyed Bright Pupil... I suspected it, but now I know for sure.
8252115.ch: 六目明瞳……她是六目明瞳……我本来也只是怀疑，没想到是真的。

8252116.en: I planned to capture Six-Eyed Bright Pupil with that cultivator. I just wanted to keep her safe... I never thought he'd try to hurt her.
8252116.ch: 我与那名修士合计想要捕捉六目明瞳，我只是想留住她……没想到那人竟出手加害。

8252117.en: I tried to stop him, but he overpowered me. Six-Eyed Bright Pupil was forced to fight back...
8252117.ch: 我想制止那人，没想到反而被其反制，六目明瞳遭袭，只有奋起还击……

8252118.en: She... didn't mean to hurt me. She was just... warning me, that's all...
8252118.ch: 她刚刚……其实也没打算对我不利，只是……只是警告我罢了……

8252119.en: Thank you for your help... I'm so grateful... Please accept this as a token of my appreciation...
8252119.ch: 多谢援手……感激不尽……这是一点心意，算是谢礼……

8252120.en: He stumbled away, muttering to himself, looking defeated...
8252120.ch: 这家伙念念叨叨的，失魂落魄的走了……

8252121.en: What am I to do? She's so reckless, willing to brave the freezing cold just to avoid me. I must keep her in the Frost Palace of Snow until she fully recovers.
8252121.ch: 这可怎么办好呢?为了躲避我，竟然不惜受那寒气侵袭，她也太鲁莽了。我一定要将她关在寒宫雪府中，让她慢慢恢复。

8252122.en: I've been tracking the Six-Eyed Bright Pupil all this way. The monster has suffered severe frost damage trying to escape me. I must catch up to it quickly.
8252122.ch: 我一路追踪六目明瞳而来，这妖兽为了躲避我的追踪，受了严重的冰冻之伤，我得赶紧追上那妖兽。

8252123.en: It's a mystical talisman passed down through my family. When activated, it creates a temporary sanctuary.
8252123.ch: 那是我家族之中的神妙道符，一旦施展，即能化为一座临时洞府。

8252124.en: Ah, I can't miss this opportunity. I need to find Six-Eyed Bright Pupil quickly. Farewell.
8252124.ch: 唉，不好，机不可失，我得赶紧找到那六目明瞳。就此别过。

8252125.en: Ahead, Lan You staggers unsteadily. Suddenly, she collapses and falls unconscious.
8252125.ch: 只见天香在前面行走摇摇欲坠，突然间她一交跌倒，晕倒地上。

8252126.en: Ah, it's you. I guess this is the end.

8252127.en: What's there to fear about death? We're all going to die eventually. It's just a matter of when.
8252127.ch: 死又有什么好害怕的？从你诞生那刻开始，死亡就已经注定是你的归宿了。这不过是个时间问题罢了。

8252128.en: Save me? Hah. I know a place where we can rest—it'll help restore my energy and drive away this cold. Let's go sit there for a while.
8252128.ch: 救我？我知道一个地方，能够涵养真元，驱散体内寒气，我们去坐一会倒是没什么。

8252129.en: Of course you can't do anything. That's what makes it interesting. This is no ordinary cold—it's the chill of the Upper Realm, and no one can resist it...
8252129.ch: 你当然没办法。正因为这样，才有趣啊。这是特殊的寒气，上界之人的寒气，谁都压制不住……

8252130.en: Ahead, the gates of the Frost Palace of Snow are closed. But you can hear voices from inside.
8252130.ch: 前方寒宫雪府门户紧闭，无法进入，但里面传出两人声音。

8252131.en: You shouldn't take any more risks.

8252133.en: Saving you wasn't easy, you know.

8252134.en: Nobody asked for your help. Can't you just leave me alone?
8252134.ch: 没有人让你来救，能不能走开？

8252135.en: That's not what I meant. I was trying to say...
8252135.ch: 我不是那个意思，我是想说……

8252136.en: Never mind. Just shut your mouth, alright?
8252136.ch: 我是想说，你别说话了，好吗？

8252138.en: The Frost Palace of Snow, built entirely of ice and snow, harbors an inexplicable warmth within its inner chamber. A fireplace flickers gently, casting a warm glow. <ta4> settles by the hearth, closing her eyes and sighing softly.
8252138.ch: 这寒宫雪府由冰雪构成，但不知为何内室之中却洋溢着一股暖意。内屋深处还有一处壁炉，里面火光闪烁，天香就着壁炉坐下，缓缓闭上眼睛，轻轻吁了口气。

8252139.en: The firelight paints the room in a cozy hue, casting a soft, rosy glow on <ta4>'s face. It's quite captivating.
8252139.ch: 壁炉火光闪闪烁烁，将内室保持在一股温暖的状态之中，一边做着的天香也因此脸上染上一股嫣红，十分好看。

8252141.en: Physical beauty is fleeting. It ages, fades, and eventually becomes unappealing. Beneath this superficial appearance often lies a grotesque truth, too horrifying for mortal eyes.
8252141.ch: 皮囊终究是外貌，会变老、变丑，终有一日，不再好看。更别说，皮囊底下，往往是狰狞的本相，见者骇人，不堪入目。

8252142.en: I think things are fine as they are. It's nice to have someone to talk to. Revealing my true, hideous form might scare you to death, and that wouldn't be pleasant, would it?
8252142.ch: 我觉得现在这样就很好，偶尔说句话还有人回应。若是显出丑陋的本相，吓死了你，反而不美。

8252143.ch: 呵，那你姑且当我说胡话好了。

8252144.en: Isn't the ultimate goal of cultivation to transcend our physical form? If we aren't afraid of the day our bodies crumble, why fear a bit of winter's chill?
8252144.ch: 修士追求难道不是超脱形体？兵解之日，粉身碎骨尚且不惧，区区冰寒，又有什么好怕的？

8252145.en: Oh? So you're worried about me, are you?

8252146.en: I'm simply curious about the fate of that icy beauty.
8252146.ch: 我就是想看见那个冰雪美人的下场。

8252147.en: Everyone feels lonely sometimes. What she truly fears is eternal isolation, the thought of which drives her to despair.
8252147.ch: 人总会感到孤独，寂寞。她抗拒的只是无穷无尽的孤独感，这让她觉得绝望。

8252148.en: Her fate is sealed. No matter what she does, she's destined to wander alone, forever trapped in a cycle of endless struggle, until she finally collapses, exhausted.
8252148.ch: 你说的命运，她今生今世都改变不了。无论如何，她都会落在循环之中，踽踽独行，最后筋疲力竭，倒地不起。

8252149.en: You've guided her onto a different path, but who's to say that path wasn't predetermined as well?
8252149.ch: 你帮助她走向了另外一种可能。可谁又能说，眼下她过着的另外一种人生，不是早早就定下了呢？

8252150.en: <ta4> glances at you, seemingly torn between conflicting emotions before approaching. She places her hand on the wall behind you, bringing her face dangerously close to yours...
8252150.ch: 天香眼光掠过你身上，随即挣扎起来，朝你走了过来。正当她来到你面前时，突然伸手按着你身后的墙上，她也因此跟你几乎贴脸站着……

8252151.en: She smiles at you while resting her hand on your waist. The atmosphere is suddenly charged with unspoken tension.
8252151.ch: 她一边微笑看着你一边伸手搭到你腰间，眼前情形，顿时暧昧到了极处。

8252153.en: What do you think I'm doing?

8252154.en: The wind has given me weak legs. I can barely stand, so I need a bit of support.
8252154.ch: 外面吹风吹出老寒腿了，我站不稳。所以得用手扶一下。

8252155.en: My hand is simply resting on your waist. What's the problem? Is that your weak spot?
8252155.ch: 搭在你腰上啊。怎么？这是你命门？

8252156.en: Oh? This thing looked familiar, so I just took a closer look.
8252156.ch: 噢？我看见这个东西很眼熟，就拿来看看了。

8252157.en: With a swift flick of her slender hand, <ta4> snatches the small knot from your waist, teasingly waving it before your eyes.
8252157.ch: 天香纤手下掠，一把扯下你腰间的小结，并拿到你面前晃了晃。

8252158.en: This little thing isn't quite cutting it anymore, is it?

8252159.en: <ta4> settles cross-legged against the wall, pulling a bundle of soft threads from her sleeve. With focused attention, she begins to weave a new knot.
8252159.ch: 天香扶着墙边慢慢盘腿坐下，她从袖中挽出一簇软丝来，然后对着小结开始编织起来。

8252160.en: You sit so close that you can feel each other's breath. After what feels like forever, <ta4> finishes the knot and returns it to your hand.
8252160.ch: 你和她之间坐得极近，彼此间呼吸可闻。良久良久天香这才编好了那个小结，并将之重新交到你手上。

8252161.en: I've been experimenting with a new knotting technique. I haven't gotten to try it out, but you had my old knot here.
8252161.ch: 我近日想了想，又有了新的打结的方法，可惜一直没得闲暇去试，正好你这边有我上次打好的结。

8252162.en: I've regained my energy. Let's go.
8252162.ch: 我坐了这一会已经恢复灵力了，这便走吧。

8252163.en: Without a word, <ta4> stands up, casts a glance at you, and leaves.
8252163.ch: 天香自顾自站了起了，她朝你看了一眼，便自行离开了。

8252164.en: You both fall silent for a moment. <ta4> concentrates on cultivating her energy. Color returns to her face as she completes the practice with a deep breath, and then stands up.
8252164.ch: 你两一时无话，天香集中精神涵养灵力，只片刻之间她脸上便重新泛上血色。她收功吐气，随即站了起来。

8252165.en: We should be going. This place isn't ours to keep.
8252165.ch: 此地不宜久留，我们这就走吧。

8252166.en: We're just temporary guests. Now that I'm recovered, let's not waste any more time.
8252166.ch: 这终究是别人的地方，我们不过临时借用，眼下我恢复过来了，何必再作耽搁？

8252168.en: Xiang Laichi is trapped in a tangled web of white silk, a helpless bee caught in a spider's web. He struggles desperately, but to no avail.
8252168.ch: 向来痴被缠无数白丝交缠束缚，观之便如落在蛛网上无助的蜜蜂。他不断挣扎，但却始终无果。

8252170.en: This is absurd! What gives?! I deciphered her... that monster's intricate knot. How could this happen...
8252170.ch: 岂有此理！怎会如此！我明明已经破解了她的……那妖怪的纵横之结，怎么会……

8252171.en: I was... tracking Six-Eyed Bright Pupil. I thought I had her cornered when she was weakened by frostbite. Just as I was about to capture her... that monster counterattacked, ensnaring me in this spider silk.
8252171.ch: 我……追踪六目明瞳，我乘着她受了冻伤，正拟一举将之拿下，没想到她……这妖物临机反扑，喷出蛛丝将我牢牢束缚住了。

8252172.en: This isn't an ordinary trap. The knots are incredibly complex, beyond the skill of any ordinary person.
8252172.ch: 这蛛网非同小可，交汇处打了结，等闲之人根本无法解开。

8252173.en: I... Ahem! Evil monsters must be eradicated! As cultivators, our purpose is to slay monsters and vanquish the demonic, breaking free from the cycle of reincarnation.
8252173.ch: 这个……咳咳！大妖为恶，人人得而诛之！我辈修士，学得一身术法，不正为斩妖除魔，脱出轮回？

8252174.en: Thank you for your help. I must continue my pursuit of that monster before I lose her trail. Please accept this as a token of my gratitude for freeing me!
8252174.ch: 多谢大能帮助，我必须尽快追上那妖物了，不然再次失去踪迹，就不易找到了。这是多谢你替我解除束缚的一点心意！

8252175.en: The man hurries away, disappearing into the distance.
8252175.ch: 此人说着，匆匆忙忙便朝远方去了。

8252176.en: Mu Xian is a vast region. Technically, she shouldn't be able to hide there.
8252176.ch: 暮仙州终究是大州，按理说她没可能躲起来的。

8252177.en: Exactly! I won't stop until I capture Six-Eyed Bright Pupil!
8252177.ch: 就是，不拿下六目明瞳，誓不罢休！

8252178.en: Well... Would a truly evil monster make it easy for you to expose its wickedness?
8252178.ch: 这个……大奸大恶的妖兽岂会让你轻易知道她作恶了呢？

8252179.en: Wh-what do you mean? What I want is to eliminate that monster! I have no other motives!
8252179.ch: 什、什么意思？我就是一门心思要除了那妖！我哪有什么别的想法？

8252180.en: Xiang Laichi looks uneasy, scratching his head. Suddenly, he summons a talisman, rides a fierce wind, and vanishes.
8252180.ch: 向来痴似乎突然变得局促不安，他抓了抓头，突然招起符咒，聚起狂风御风而去了。

8252181.en: <ta4> stands atop a mountain peak that overlooks Mu Xian, gazing intently towards Chi You. Her eyes seem filled with deep concern.
8252181.ch: 只见天香正在一处山巅俯瞰暮仙州景色，她凝神看着远方赤幽州方向，眼中似乎充满忧心。

8252182.en: What brings you here this time? Are you off playing house with strangers again?
8252182.ch: 你又来做什么？帮着旁人建房子搭伙过日子吗？

8252183.en: Her stiff body is quite extraordinary. If you insist on helping her, you might do more harm than good. One wrong move, and you could end up hurting her.
8252183.ch: 她那木头身体非同一般，你非要帮助她，没准要弄巧成拙。一不小心，指不定还害了她。

8252184.en: Who in this world doesn't deserve pity? You may find her pitiful, but the Heavens might not.
8252184.ch: 这世上，谁又不可怜？你以为是可怜，上苍可未必这么看。

8252185.en: Facts can be harsh and difficult to accept. But it's these truths that we must face.
8252185.ch: 事实总是冰冷的，让人无法接受的。但这恰恰是我们需要接受的。

8252186.en: Perhaps I'm just curious to see what fate awaits that stiff lady.
8252186.ch: 没准我就是想看看那木头人儿，最后会落得个怎样的下场呢？

8252187.en: That's going too far. I'm simply interested in her destiny. This world is cruel; if the Heavens don't care, why should I?
8252187.ch: 这话就过了，我不过是想看看她的结局。天地不仁，上天没有眷顾那木头人，我又凭什么去操心？

8252188.en: Help her? She's the only one who can truly help herself. No matter what we do, it's ultimately futile.
8252188.ch: 帮她？能帮她的只有她自己，我们做再多，都是徒劳。

8252189.en: That place might hold the final piece of this world's secret map. There, we could uncover many mysteries.
8252189.ch: 那边也许就是八荒秘密的最后一块版图了。也许那边就能发现很多意思的秘密呢。

8252190.en: A hint of satisfaction flickers across <ta4>'s face. She gazes into the distance before bidding farewell and leaving.
8252190.ch: 天香脸上似乎有隐含一丝得意之色，她目视远方良久这才与你别过，转身而去。

8252191.en: In an open field, <ta4> is weaving with silken threads, creating an intricate pattern that stretches east and south.
8252191.ch: 天香正在一处旷野编织以丝线编织着什么。她时而向东方发出丝线，时而朝南方射出，只片刻便成了一个奇特的形状。

8252193.en: I'm thinking about how to gather forces from all four corners.
8252193.ch: 我在想怎么样可以将四方力量聚拢过来。

8252195.ch: 哼，来了更多的不速之客了。

8252196.en: Suddenly, a horde of Bambuki surrounds you.
8252196.ch: 只见前方一只只竹妖围住了你们。

8252197.en: Would you be so kind as to deal with them? If I intervene, who knows what other trouble I might attract?
8252197.ch: 你帮我打发了吧。我若出手，指不定又要惹上对头。

8252198.en: That fellow is becoming quite a threat.
8252198.ch: 那家伙倒是越来越厉害了。

8252199.en: True, they're all here to scope out the area.

8252200.en: Mere nuisances, not worth our time.
8252200.ch: 无足轻重的人罢了，不必理会。

8252201.en: Suddenly, dust swirls about, plunging the surroundings into pitch-black darkness. Nothing can be seen.
8252201.ch: 正在此时，突然间周围尘埃相继升起，周围顿时陷入混沌之中，漆黑一片，根本无法看见任何东西。

8252203.en: The moment you said that, I couldn't agree more.
8252203.ch: 就从你说这话开始，我也这么想了。

8252204.en: With nothing but darkness, perhaps we could do something special.
8252204.ch: 面前乌漆嘛黑的，或者我们可以做些有意思的事。

8252206.en: In the darkness, you feel <ta4> move closer, embracing you tightly.
8252206.ch: 黑暗之中，你似乎感觉天香靠了过来，投在你怀里，抱住了你。

8252207.en: As <ta4> speaks, you feel her fumbling behind you, removing something. A flash of fire illuminates the darkness, revealing her holding a burning talisman. In an instant, the talisman is consumed, plunging the surroundings back into darkness.
8252207.ch: 天香说着在你背后摸索一阵，突然从你身上摘下了什么。继而面前火光一亮，黑暗中可见天香手中捻着一张烧着的灵符，但只片刻间，灵符燃尽，周围又复漆黑。

8252209.en: As I suspected, those little monsters planted it during the fight. It was buried within you, feeding on your energy. I had to attune myself to your energy flow to locate and remove it.
8252209.ch: 如我所料不差，那是刚才的小妖小怪借交手之际种下的。符咒埋于你体内，借你灵力运作。不得已，我唯有试着感知你体内灵力运行，起出符咒。

8252211.en: Perhaps you'd like to embrace me and remove mine? You could feel the energy flow within me. How does that sound?
8252211.ch: 要么你也来抱抱我，感知我体内灵力运行，然后将符咒起出，如何？

8252212.en: Just as you move to embrace <ta4>, a flash of fire illuminates the darkness. She has already removed the talisman.
8252212.ch: 你正要上前抱住天香，未料眼前火光再现，她已从自己身上起出符咒。

8252213.en: Sorry, I don't need your help. I've already found it.
8252213.ch: 抱歉，不劳你帮忙，我已经找到了。

8252214.en: A hint of amusement flickers in <ta4>'s usually serious eyes. She waves the talisman, dispelling the chaos. The majestic landscape of mountains and rivers reappears.
8252214.ch: 一向雍容严肃的天香眼中透出一丝笑意。随后她扬了扬手中符纸，周围混沌散去，重见四方山川景致。

8252216.en: <ta4> takes the small knot from your waist and reties it carefully before handing it back to you.
8252216.ch: 天香摘下你腰间小结，然后专注地绑了起来，不多时，她将小结重新绑好交到你手上。

8252217.en: Consider this a token of my gratitude for dealing with those monsters.
8252217.ch: 你替我对付了那些小妖小怪，这算是谢礼。

8252218.en: From afar, <ta4> surveys the landscape. Sensing your approach, she glances at you briefly before returning to the view.
8252218.ch: 天香于远处俯瞰面前景观，她察觉你的接近，眼角余光往你身上一瞟，便又继续注视前方。

8252219.en: So, how does it feel? Now that you've brought that stiff lady back to life, how are you feeling?
8252219.ch: 怎样？救活了那木头人儿了，心情如何？

8252220.en: Every action, every decision, leaves a mark on the world. Those who suffer, even if they escape one calamity, will face another. No one is exempt.
8252220.ch: 每一个人每一个决定都会都世上造成影响。受到苦难的人，即使避了此劫，也避不了彼劫。没有人可以例外。

8252221.en: Your guilt over influencing this world is unnecessary.
8252221.ch: 你为对八荒造成影响而内疚，实在大可不必。

8252222.en: What's destined to happen will happen. It's a simple fact of reality, not some philosophical notion.
8252222.ch: 只要有机会发生的就一定会发生，此为不易之理。不是我看得开，事实如此罢了。

8252223.en: I wonder if, after all her sacrifices, she truly achieved her desire. Even if she escaped her controller, she's merely traded one predicament for another. In this world, who isn't bound by rules?
8252223.ch: 只不知，付出这一切后，她是不是真的如愿了。摆脱了那个控制她的人又如何呢？她也不过是从这个局走到另外一个局中，试问八荒之内，谁又不是受“规则”压制？

8252224.en: From this perspective, before transcendence, we're all puppets on strings. The stiff lady's struggles haven't fundamentally changed her fate.
8252224.ch: 由此观之，我们在超脱飞升之前，也不过是一具具木偶罢了。木头人儿的努力并未让她有真正的改变。

8252225.en: You might think I'm heartless, but you can't truly understand detachment without experiencing desperate struggle and bitter suffering.
8252225.ch: 你也许会觉得我冷漠。但如非苦苦挣扎过，体味过当中的痛苦，又怎会变得冷漠？

8252226.en: Being able to make a good choice often means the choice itself is inconsequential. In crucial moments, we're often forced into a no-win situation, where every path leads to error.
8252226.ch: 能作出好的选择，只能说明那不过是无关紧要的选择。而我们的情况往往是无从选择，因为怎么选，都是错的。

8252227.en: Perhaps our only option is to choose the path of least immediate harm or the one that offers the most long-term benefit.
8252227.ch: 也许我们只能选对当下损害没那么大的，又或者只能选择长远来说更好的。

8252228.en: By the way, I'm leaving. After all I've done for you, don't you think a thank you is in order?
8252228.ch: 话说，我要离开了，帮了你这么多，你不道个谢？

8252229.en: I was intrigued by the stiff lady's story, but now it's over.
8252229.ch: 我对木头人的事感兴趣，现在她的事情已经告一段落了。

8252230.en: I've helped you more than you realize. For example, you came to me to unburden yourself, and I listened. Do you feel better now?
8252230.ch: 帮了，你不知道而已。就说现在，你找我吐露心声，我不就给予回应了？好过多了吧？

8252231.en: Your words ring hollow. Perhaps a lesson is in order.

8252232.en: With a flick of her hand, <ta4> releases sparks of ember. You feel a warm sensation on your hand as a mysterious mark appears and disappears.
8252232.ch: 天香挥手间放出几点余烬，同时你感觉手背微微一热，一个印纹现于手心，同时瞬间消失。

8252233.en: <ta4> smiles gently after casting the spell. You catch a glimpse of her flickering twice before disappearing into the distance.
8252233.ch: 天香施过法了，朝你笑笑，你但觉倩影闪了两闪，人已在远处了。

8252234.en: Oh? I didn't expect such sincerity from you. May you always live true to yourself.
8252234.ch: 哦？没想到还挺诚心的。盼你从今而后，都能跟随自己心意而活吧。

8252235.en: <ta4> gently lifts your palm, and then traces a delicate pattern across your knuckles. A faint, ethereal mark shimmers into existence before vanishing just as quickly.
8252235.ch: 天香轻轻扶起你的手掌，在你手背轻轻划了几下，一个印纹闪现继而消失。

8252236.en: She smiles gently after casting the spell. You catch a glimpse of her flickering twice before disappearing into the distance.
8252236.ch: 她施法罢了，便朝你笑笑。你但觉倩影闪了两闪，人已在远处了。

8252237.en: I won't let you go ahead.

8252238.en: I've shown you endless patience, but you push me too far. If this continues, don't blame me for showing no mercy.
8252238.ch: 我对你百般容忍，你却处处相逼。再是如此，不要怪我辣手无情。

8252239.en: The cultivator brandishes a glowing yellow talisman, commanding the Bambuki to surround and capture you. <ta4> responds with an elegant gesture of her slender hand, summoning ethereal threads that weave and dance through the air, ensnaring the creatures.
8252239.ch: 修士手捻黄符，驱使竹妖四处围堵。天香纤手招处，道道丝线蜿蜒穿梭，交缠场上妖物。

8252240.en: As both of them unleash their powers, a cacophony of crackling energy fills the air. The Bambuki snap and crumble, falling to the ground, defeated. Suddenly, the threads ignite without warning, causing a blinding explosion. When the dust settles, <ta4> has vanished without a trace.
8252240.ch: 两人各自发力，但听长上噼啪声响，竹妖已经纷纷断折倒地，无法再战。同时丝线无故自燃，发生爆炸。尘埃落定后，天香已不见人影。

8252241.en: Oh crap! She's escaped again! I can't let her continue this. I simply can't!
8252241.ch: 可恶！又丢了！我不能让她继续！决不能！

8252242.en: The cultivator stomps his foot in frustration, waving the talisman in his hand. Powerful air currents swirl around him, forming a vortex. In an instant, he harnesses the wind and vanishes into the sky.
8252242.ch: 修士猛一跺脚，晃动手中符契，周边聚起气流涌动，他已御风而去。

8252243.en: The small knot of white silk threads at your waist begins to vibrate strangely. Upon closer inspection, you notice each thread pulsing with energy, resonating with an unseen force.
8252243.ch: 你走在路上，突然感觉大地无故震颤，砂石泥尘似乎受到某种力量影响纷纷浮空。此时轰隆声大作，似乎远方有修士正比斗恶战。

8252244.en: In the distance, two streams of energy collide, shattering into a dazzling display of starlight across the sky. <ta4> waves her hand, unleashing a torrent of white silk to ensnare the cultivator. The opponent, in turn, continuously burns away the approaching threads with talismans.
8252244.ch: 远方两股灵力互相交击，在天上碎成星星光华。只见{name|B}拂手放出白丝猛缠修士，对方则不断以灵符烧毁接近的白丝。

8252245.en: Today, I'll subdue you and lock you away!
8252245.ch: 今日就要将你拿下，把你关起来！

8252246.en: Got a death wish? Keep pushing me, and I won't show any mercy.
8252246.ch: 不要命了是吧？再苦苦相逼的话，可别怪我手下无情。

8252247.en: Just then, a horde of monsters burst from the ground, haunted by Nether Air. They swarm towards both {name|B} and the cultivator.
8252247.ch: 正在此时，大量冒着冥气的妖兽从地上冒出，纷纷扑向{name|B}与修士。

8252248.en: It's you! The monsters are overwhelming. Help me fight them off while I deal with this one!
8252248.ch: 是你！妖兽势大，你助我退敌。我先收拾了眼前这人再说！

8252249.en: Well done, your power has grown. Now, if you wouldn't mind, let's clear out these other cultivators.
8252249.ch: 很好，实力又有提升。不过眼前这些修仙者也得麻烦你帮忙清理清理。

8252251.en: Why waste time? Two others have already tried. Let's capture her—you take an arm, I'll take a leg!
8252251.ch: 还说什么？眼前已有两人捷足先登，拿下她，分你一条臂膀，我要她一条大腿！

8252252.en: No, wait! Hear me out! I'm not trying to—
8252252.ch: 不是，你们听我说！我不是要……

8252254.en: I don't care if they're gods or demons. Anyone who interferes dies.
8252254.ch: 管他是天上的神仙，还是地下的阎罗，敢来抢夺，也一并杀了！

8252255.en: Excellent, we've dealt with these weaklings. Now it's your turn!
8252255.ch: 很好，这些虾兵蟹将都料理了。接下来就是你了！

8252256.en: <ta4>'s delicate silk threads, soft as a whisper, ensnare Xiang Laichi's limbs, binding him tightly. In that instant, <ta4> vanishes into thin air. Xiang bitterly cuts through the silk, freeing himself. As he gazes into the distance, a wave of frustration washes over him.
8252256.ch: {name|B}白丝有绕指之柔，只一下就缠住了向来痴手足，将之缚住。与此同时，{name|B}身影乱晃，早已消失在远处。向来痴悻悻的切断缠绕自己的白丝，解开了自己的束缚，看着远方，不觉一阵怅然。

8252257.en: Oh crap! She's got away again!

8252258.en: Kill her? No! I just want to imprison her!
8252258.ch: 杀她？我只是要将她关起来！

8252259.en: Blast it all! Every time, victory slips away at the last moment!
8252259.ch: 不好不好！每次都功败垂成！

8252260.en: I've no more time for talk. I must capture her at all costs.
8252260.ch: 我不与你说了，我必须将她拿下。

8252261.en: As Xiang Laichi speaks, he waves the talisman. A whirlwind engulfs him, and in an instant, he's gone.
8252261.ch: 向来痴说着，晃动手中符咒，身绕旋风，急急去远了。

8252262.en: Looking up, you see <ta4> sitting cross-legged, healing her wounds. Surrounding <ta4> are several little monsters, forming three tight circles, ready to strike.
8252262.ch: 抬头看去，不远处{name|B}正盘膝坐好，似乎正在运转灵力，自愈伤势。她身边若干小妖严严实实围了三层，正准备伺机而发。

8252264.en: Before <ta4> can finish, monsters charge from all directions.
8252264.ch: {name|B}还要再说，四方妖兽已朝你猛冲而至。

8252265.en: Hee hee... Caught you at last, you little troublemaker...
8252265.ch: 桀桀桀……逮到你了……坏事的东西……

8252266.en: He hee... This time, my prey won't escape...

8252267.en: Two Nether Demons advance menacingly. Simultaneously, a horde of monsters emerges from nowhere, encircling the area completely.
8252267.ch: 两只冥妖步步逼近，同时周围不知从何处又冒出大量妖兽，将此地围个水泄不通。

8252269.en: Suddenly, a blinding white light flashes across <ta4>'s body, illuminating the surroundings. In your daze, you glimpse a colossal shadow battling fiercely with the Nether Demons. Moments later, as the light fades, the Nether Demons are defeated, and <ta4> stands nearby, panting heavily.
8252269.ch: {name|B}身上突然闪烁寒芒，周围所见尽是白光。恍惚之中，你似乎看见一个巨影倏忽来去与冥妖战作一团。片刻后，光芒淡去，只见冥妖已被消灭，而{name|B}亦在一旁呼呼喘气。

8252270.en: Suddenly, Xiang Laichi descends from the sky, his talismans transforming into meteors that crash into the demon horde. Caught off guard, <ta4> quickly conjures several Mirror Images and vanishes in the blink of an eye.
8252270.ch: 突然间，向来痴从天而降，手中灵符化作天陨，猛击群妖。{name|B}大吃一惊，连化幻身，眨眼间已去得远了。

8252271.en: Oh crap! I was too slow!

8252272.en: How is this possible? She got away again!

8252273.en: Capture her? You've got it all wrong! I'm trying to protect her!

8252274.en: I wish I knew! Every time she escapes, her tricks get more sophisticated. It's a never-ending game of cat and mouse.
8252274.ch: 我也很想知道，每次逃离后，她提防我的方法就变得也更高明！这真是个无穷无尽的困局。

8252275.en: Geez, I can't talk any longer. She's in grave danger, and time is of the essence! I must find her immediately! Farewell!
8252275.ch: 唉！我不与你说了，她如今危在旦夕，片刻耽搁不得！我得赶紧去找她！再见！

8252276.en: Once again, the small knot at your waist pulses with energy, emitting a mysterious tremor...
8252276.ch: 你腰间的小结再次无故充盈灵力，发出震颤……

8252277.en: A thunderous explosion erupts ahead, as the force of an energy blast disperses in all directions. Through the thick cloud of dust, you see a wall of white silk threads crack open. Inside, Six-Eyed Bright Pupil pins one cultivator to the ground while devouring another.
8252277.ch: 前方发出轰隆一声震响，灵爆之力四散溢出。茫茫烟尘之中课件前方白丝织成的墙壁开裂一口，里面六目明瞳逮住一名修士将之按在地上，另一名修士则被其咬在口中，正一点一点的进行吞咽。

8252279.en: Xiang Laichi's loud shout catches Six-Eyed Bright Pupil's attention. It lets out a shrill cry, spits out the cultivator, and leaps far away.
8252279.ch: 向来痴高声喝阻，惹起了六目明瞳的注意。它发出一声啸叫，吐出了正在吞噬的修士，只一跃便远远跳开了。

8252280.en: You're not getting away this time!

8252281.en: Xiang Laichi waves his hand, unleashing a talisman. A giant golden claw descends, swiftly capturing Six-Eyed Bright Pupil. The mythical beast, shrouded in a strange fog, is revealed to be <ta4>!
8252281.ch: 向来痴晃手间扬出符咒，金光恍如大爪，一下便将六目明瞳拖了下来。这大妖兽似乎受到什么影响，不断冒出烟气，到浓雾散尽时，却发现乃是{name|B}！

8252282.en: You cast your spell by exploiting my weakness. I had no chance to defend myself.
8252282.ch: 你乘我虚弱，突然施术，我根本无从化解。

8252283.en: My intent was not to challenge you, but to bring you back and protect you.
8252283.ch: 我不是跟你较量，而是要将你拿回去。好好保护你。

8252284.en: Protect me? You mean keeping me caged like a pet?
8252284.ch: 保护？是指珍而重之地将我圈养起来吗？

8252285.en: Well... it's not exactly that, but I suppose it's close...
8252285.ch: 这个……有点差别，但好像也差不多……

8252286.en: In that case, I decline your offer.

8252287.en: Unnoticed, <ta4> had already broken free from the spell. In the blink of an eye, she vanished like a phantom. Xiang Laichi, stunned, gives chase...
8252287.ch: 不知何时，{name|B}已挣脱符咒束缚。她一得脱困，身如幻影，去似疾风，只眨眼间就没影儿了。向来痴大惊，忙不迭紧追而去……

8252288.en: (The silk knot {name|B} gave can sense her location. Get closer, and she would be there.)
8252288.ch: （{name|B}所赠缠丝百结似能探查其所在，若再接近，必能察觉其所在。）

8252289.en: Fellow cultivator, be careful! Get too close, and she'll sense us!
8252289.ch: 道友，再接近就要被她发现了！

8252290.en: Despite Xiang Laichi's hushed tone, Six-Eyed Bright Pupil notices. It lets out a shrill cry, spits out the cultivator, and leaps away.
8252290.ch: 向来痴轻声说话，未料还是惹起了六目明瞳的注意。它发出一声啸叫，吐出了正在吞噬的修士，只一跃便远远跳开了。

8252291.en: The silk knot on your body pulses with energy. Six-Eyed Bright Pupil must be weaving its silk nearby.
8252291.ch: 身上缠丝百结再次充盈灵力，附近必是六目明瞳编织吐丝之处。

8252292.en: At the horizon where earth meets sky stands a mysterious monolith. Silk threads weave around its surface, marking it as something far from natural.
8252292.ch: 远方地天交界处屹立一块奇异巨石，周边缠绕丝线，不像天然生成之物。

8252294.en: I'm intrigued. Those who've hunted me couldn't find this place. How did you manage it? Ah, the knot.
8252294.ch: 我倒是觉得稀奇，千方百计追踪我的人尚且找不到这里。你究竟是怎么找到这边来的？原来靠的是缠丝百结。

8252295.en: I wove the knot with a unique technique, the same technique I used to weave my thread as a defense. When you approached, my silk threads resonated with the knot, leading you here.
8252295.ch: 我以特殊手法编织缠丝百结，又以相同手法编织丝线，构成防御，你一旦接近，我的丝线顿生共鸣，你也因此找到了我。

8252296.en: As you see, I'm Six-Eyed Bright Pupil, an arachnid monster.
8252296.ch: 如你所见，我就是六目明瞳，一只蜘蛛之妖。

8252297.en: Deceive you? I never claimed to be human. I simply assumed human form to avoid trouble.
8252297.ch: 骗你？我好像从未说过我跟你们一样，是人。我只是变作人身省得惹来麻烦罢了。

8252298.en: Fighting two Nether Demons at once was perilous. I had no choice but to reveal my true form. By surprising them, I defeated them and escaped.
8252298.ch: 一只冥妖不易应付，更何况两只齐上？当时局势危险，我只得现出真身，出其不意，击倒冥妖，咱们才能脱困。

8252299.en: But a Nether Demon wounded me. I had to find a secluded place to recover. I didn't have the strength to maintain my mirror image. Two cultivators attacked, so I had to reveal my true form to defeat them. That's what you saw.
8252299.ch: 可惜，冥妖还是伤了我，无可奈何之下，我只得觅地静养。当时我无力维持幻身，两个修士摸到我身边来要对我下手，无奈下只能用真身击败他们，这些都是你看见的了。

8252300.en: Cultivators killing monsters is common, especially in Chi You, where they're natural enemies.
8252300.ch: 修士杀妖，再正常不过，更何况赤幽州中，修士与妖怪势同水火？

8252301.en: Want to know more? Follow me.

8252302.en: {name|B} leads you down a hidden passage until you find yourself plummeting into a deep valley. There, suspended in the air, you see a massive purple crystal nestled between colossal stalactites. The crystal anchors a huge web woven from countless white silk threads. These threads crisscross and extend in all directions, disappearing into the horizon.
8252302.ch: {name|B}带你从暗道一直往下，跃入一处深谷之中。只见空中由巨型钟乳夹着一块巨大的紫晶，紫晶则是无数白丝织成的巨网，这些丝线纵横交错一直延伸开去，不见尽头。

8252303.en: This is one of Chi You's ley lines. Once, a mythical beast, corrupted by Nether Air, lost its mind and controlled it. After defeating the beast, I claimed this place as my own.
8252303.ch: 此处是赤幽州的其中一个地脉，原为大妖兽把控，它受冥气劫持，失去常性，我将之击杀后占据此处。

8252304.en: These spider silk threads are all my work. They interconnect the various underground ley lines. Whenever energy flows through these lines, my silk senses it and transmits the information back here.
8252304.ch: 这些都是我吐出的蛛丝，彼此间沟通着地底各处地脉。地脉之中一旦有灵力来往，我的蛛丝都能感知，传回此处。

8252305.en: Through these silk threads, I monitor the power flowing through the ley lines of this world. In this way, the secrets of our world will eventually be laid bare before my eyes.
8252305.ch: 而我则借着这些蛛丝观察着八荒地脉的力量，这样一来，八荒的秘密最终会呈现在我的眼前。

8252306.en: It's hard to say. It could take ten years, a hundred years, or even a thousand. The world has existed for countless ages. How could anyone hope to reverse-engineer its formation through ley lines in the blink of an eye?
8252306.ch: 这我拿不准，但也许十年，也许一百年，也许一千年。八荒形成已久，要想从地脉倒推八荒形成，岂是一朝一夕之事？

8252307.en: Today, I use this ley line as a base to monitor all the ley lines of the world. In the future, it won't be difficult to use this world as a foundation to explore the infinite universe beyond.
8252307.ch: 今日我以此地脉为据点观察八荒所有地脉，日后不难以八荒为据点查探这无穷无尽的宇宙。

8252308.en: It depends on your definition of "malicious intent." He probably doesn't want to kill me, but he'd love to capture and imprison me.
8252308.ch: 那要看你怎么界定“恶意”二字了。这家伙大概是不会想要了我性命的，但他会想把我抓了关起来。

8252310.en: From now on, I'll remain here, and you're welcome to visit me. The Nether Demons and monsters in Chi You are incredibly powerful, so let me teach you a special technique that might help you deal with them.
8252310.ch: 从今往后，我都会留在此处，你可以来这找我。赤幽州中冥妖与妖兽都十分强大，我这有一门妙法或能助你应付妖兽，也传给你吧。

8252311.en: As <ta4> speaks, she turns to face the purple crystal in the air. A faint blush creeps across her cheeks...
8252311.ch: 说着{name|B}转身看着虚悬的地脉紫晶，你仿佛间似乎看见她脸上透出一抹嫣红……

8252312.en: As you enter the ley line, you find <ta4> seated beneath the ley line crystal. She grips several silk threads. These threads usually hang motionless, but occasionally they quiver, producing a humming sound like a plucked Guqin.
8252312.ch: 你进入地脉之中，只见{name|B}正坐于地脉晶体下方，双手各抓着几根丝线，这些丝线一般纹丝不动，但有时却颤抖起来，嗡嗡的有鼓瑟弹琴之响。

8252313.en: Suddenly, countless streams of purple power surge along the silk threads from afar, converging on <ta4>. As she absorbs this energy, her brow furrows and eyelids flutter, a sign of great discomfort. Finally, she opens her eyes and looks at you.
8252313.ch: 这时无数紫色的力量远方沿丝线不断逼近，最后汇聚到{name|B}身上。她接受了这些力量后眉头皱起，眼睑微微鼓动，似乎十分不适。片刻后她终于睁开眼朝你看来。

8252314.en: It's pitch black down here. Aside from the purple crystal above me and the silk threads I've spun, there's nothing else. It's rare for you to visit.
8252314.ch: 这里黑麻麻一片，除去头顶这块紫晶，和我吐出的丝线，什么都没有，难得你也专程过来。

8252315.en: <ta4> walks towards you, feet treading lightly on the spider web. As she reaches you, she suddenly faints and collapses to her knees.
8252315.ch: {name|B}脚踩蛛网，慢慢朝你走来，正好来到你面前时突然一阵虚软，一下跪倒。

8252316.en: With your help, <ta4> steadies herself. For a brief moment, she seems to glance at her hand in yours, then turns back to the purple crystal, casually withdrawing her hand.
8252316.ch: {name|B}由你扶持，走了几步这才站定了，仿佛间她似乎将眼光瞟向被你握着的手，然后回身指点紫晶，顺便将手抽回。

8252317.en: This purple crystal is actually the Nether Air condensation. These condensations seem to hold hidden messages, communicating with each other. And this is just one of the countless wonders within the world.
8252317.ch: 这块紫晶其实是冥气结晶，结晶彼此之间有似乎暗藏消息来去。仅是这八荒之中就有无数有趣的东西。

8252318.en: I use my energy to secretly decipher the information exchanged between the purple crystals. It's draining, that's all.
8252318.ch: 我以灵力暗察紫晶之间交流的信息，耗损心神，仅此而已。

8252319.en: Since you're here, let's go for a walk. While we're at it, I'll do humanity a favor and clear out a few Nether Demons.
8252319.ch: 既然来了，我们出去逛逛，顺便帮你们人类清理几个冥妖。

8252320.en: Ahead, the Nether Demons lumber along, slowly making their way towards <ta4>'s dwelling...
8252320.ch: 前方冥妖慢悠悠的走着，似乎逐步朝{name|B}的住处行进……

8252321.en: The Nether Demons are bound by my silk threads, greatly weakening them. If we're going to strike, now's the perfect time.
8252321.ch: 冥妖被我丝线牵制，实力大减，要出手的话现在正是良机。

8252322.en: You should be grateful to me, shouldn't you?

8252323.en: I've eliminated a threat to your Cultivator Alliance and all cultivators. Don't you think I deserve a proper thank you?
8252323.ch: 为你们仙盟、为你们修仙者击杀了眼中钉，肉中刺，不该好好给我道谢一番？

8252324.en: These Nether Demons are all mindless and dumb. I can't be bothered to figure out what's going on in their heads.
8252324.ch: 冥妖一个个呆子似的，我没心思弄明白他们在想什么。

8252325.en: Very well. For that expression of gratitude, I'm inclined to help you kill a few more Nether Demons. But let's call it a day. I'll return to my humble abode to continue my research on the ley lines.
8252325.ch: 很好，冲你这句道谢，我倒乐意帮你再杀几只冥妖。今儿就到这吧，我回小筑继续查探地脉的信息。

8252326.en: <ta4> looks utterly exhausted. With a soft sigh, she slowly takes her leave...
8252326.ch: {name|B}似乎十分疲惫，轻轻吁了口气，便慢慢离开了……

8252327.en: As you enter the ley line, you find <ta4> not using her silk to collect information from the ley lines. Instead, she sits on the web, relaxed, gazing at the purple crystal nearby.
8252327.ch: 你进入地脉之中，{name|B}没有借吐丝收集地脉信息，她只是舒展着身体坐在网上，遥遥看着不远处的地脉紫晶。

8252328.en: Sneaking up without a word, huh? Did I give you permission to visit?
8252328.ch: 一声不吭的摸过来，得到我同意了吗？

8252329.en: Interesting. So you've got a silver tongue now?
8252329.ch: 有意思，还耍起嘴皮子来了。

8252330.en: I'm simply checking these ley lines. If cultivators or monsters were to transcend their realm, ascending from the world, would Nether Air exist in other realms as well?
8252330.ch: 我就是看看这地脉。假如修仙者或妖兽超脱本位面，由八荒飞升而去。那么在别的位面是不是也会有冥气？

8252331.en: Could the existence of Nether Air be a fundamental law of this infinite universe?
8252331.ch: 冥气的存在是不是这无穷宇宙之中的其中一项法则？

8252332.en: The ley line purple crystals don't constantly transmit information. They follow a pattern, a way of their own—a way of information transfer. What's truly astounding is that this way of information transfer seems to have been exploited.
8252332.ch: 地脉紫晶不是每时每刻都会传输彼此间的信息的。他们更有规律，他们有自己的道，传输信息的道。更为匪夷所思的是，他们传递信息的道似乎也被旁人利用了。

8252333.en: Tired? Not really. After all, there will be plenty of time to rest later. No need to worry about that now.
8252333.ch: 累？还好。毕竟以后有的是机会休息。也不差现在。

8252334.en: Besides, understanding the way between heaven and earth, uncovering the hidden laws of the Eight Wildernesses—it's truly fascinating. It's enough to make me forget all my troubles.
8252334.ch: 再说，了解天地之间的道，了解八荒暗中的规律着实有趣，这足以让我乐而忘疲。

8252336.en: Yes, that's an order. Come here and sit.

8252337.en: You always do what I say. It'd be nice to have a subordinate like you. Loyal, with no hidden agenda.
8252337.ch: 真听话。若是能收罗一个这样的下属还是不错的。忠心，不会对我有所企图。

8252338.en: But of course, you're human. Men and monsters head for different paths. In the end, we're not the same.
8252338.ch: 也是，你终究是人类，人妖殊途，你我终究不是一类。

8252339.en: Tell me, do I seem strange to you?
8252339.ch: 你说，我看起来很奇怪吗？

8252340.en: Yeah, we're not the same species. Humans are all about politeness and manners, but I don't need that.
8252340.ch: 是啊，毕竟我们不是一个种族，人类喜欢彬彬有礼，而我却不需要。

8252341.en: Perhaps you've just gotten used to my eccentricities.
8252341.ch: 有没有可能你只是见怪不怪了？

8252342.en: How about this? You list all my flaws that you find very hard to accept.
8252342.ch: 这样吧，我给你个机会，让你历数我那让人难以接受的缺点好了。

8252343.en: How can one truly understand without objective observation?
8252343.ch: 若不冷眼旁观，怎得来真知灼见？

8252344.en: Impulsiveness might be the human way, but not for us. Over the centuries, I've survived through one thing: observation.
8252344.ch: 鲁莽可能是人类的进取之道，但于我们不是。长久的岁月里，我能够保有性命，靠的就是观察。

8252345.en: I observe the cycles of the sun and moon, the balance of yin and yang. I study human behavior and the intentions of my fellow creatures. This is how I navigate the perilous path of life.
8252345.ch: 观察日月变化，阴阳轮转，观察人类的举动，观察同类的心意，这样我才能趋利避害，于性命搏杀之中存活下来。

8252346.en: So you think I look down on all living things? In reality, I'm simply more focused on other matters.
8252346.ch: 所以你觉得我蔑视众生？其实我只是更专注看着别处，更关心别的东西罢了。

8252347.en: You're not being entirely honest. Very well then. I'll show you my true self.
8252347.ch: 你这么说就显得有点不诚实了。也罢，那就让你感受一下真正的我好了。

8252348.en: With a flick of <ta4>'s finger, a strand of white silk unfurls, wrapping around yours. This silken thread connects you to her. Through it, you clearly feel her heartbeat, pulse, and the flow of energy. It's as if you can perceive every detail of her body.
8252348.ch: {name|B}葱指一弹，一条白丝从她食指绕来，搭到你食指上绕了几圈缠住了你。这根白丝将你和{name|B}牵在一起，透过白丝，你分明感受到她心跳脉搏，灵力流动，似乎她体内一切动静都能清晰感知。

8252349.en: <ta4> exhales, relaxes, and stretches before settling beside you.
8252349.ch: {name|B}放松似的吁了口气，舒展着身体就这么静静的在你身边坐着。

8252350.en: You sense <ta4>'s heart racing and slowing, filled with joy but also anxiety.
8252350.ch: 你感受到{name|B}的心跳时快时慢，心中似乎充斥着欢喜，又似乎夹杂着紧张与不安。

8252351.en: You can feel that <ta4>'s heart calms down. She seems at peace, her energy and spirit steady. She closes her eyes, savoring this moment of connection.
8252351.ch: 你可以感受到{name|B}的心跳最终稳定下来，她似乎很安心，全身灵力、精神也趋于稳定，其时她闭起了眼，似乎十分享受这一切。

8252352.en: As you start to leave, the silk thread connecting you to <ta4> remains. She stands up, smiling, and gently breaks the thread. Then, she ties another knot onto the tangle of silk on your hand.
8252352.ch: 你才站起，手中丝线拉住了你和{name|B}。{name|B}微笑站起，轻轻扯断丝线，然后在你的缠丝百结上又绑上另外一道结。

8252353.en: Keep this thread as a reminder of this relentless monster. I have things to attend to, so I'll be going. Farewell.
8252353.ch: 这根线留给你好了，让你记住有这么个不近人情的妖物。我有点事要办，外出一下，再见。

8252354.en: With that, <ta4> leaves without looking back.

8252355.en: It seems you understand me quite well, but I can't say the same about you.
8252355.ch: 看来你还是挺了解我的，不过我却不大了解你。

8252358.en: You sense <ta4>'s heart racing and slowing, filled with joy, but also a touch of anxiety.
8252358.ch: 你感受到{name|B}的心跳时快时慢，心中似乎充斥着欢喜，又似乎夹杂着意思紧张不安。

8252363.en: Fellow cultivator, could you come here for a moment?

8252364.en: Fellow cultivator, I've lost track of Six-Eyed Bright Pupil.
8252364.ch: 道友，近日我再也追踪不了六目明瞳了。

8252365.en: Fellow cultivator, hear me out. While Six-Eyed Bright Pupil is a powerful being, I mean no harm to her!
8252365.ch: 道友，听我一言。六目明瞳虽是大妖，但我对其并无恶意！

8252366.en: Six-Eyed Bright Pupil is exceptionally gifted and has long cultivated a human form. She's calm and wise, interested only in arcane wisdom. This has put her in great danger.
8252366.ch: 六目明瞳天赋异禀，早已修成人身。她冷静睿智，只对隐秘难知的东西感兴趣，这让她陷入了极大的危险当中。

8252367.en: That's not all. Now, all the factions in Chi You are trying to capture her. She's in grave danger.
8252367.ch: 这还不止，现在赤幽州各方势力都要将她拿下。她实在是万分危急。

8252368.en: Indeed. Capturing her is the only way to protect her from herself.
8252368.ch: 不错。唯有将她抓起来，她才不至于自己乱来。

8252369.en: Well... In the entire world, monsters who can take human form are incredibly rare. She's one of them, making her extremely valuable. I can't bear the thought of such a rare being meeting a tragic end.
8252369.ch: 这、这……八荒之中，能够修成人身的妖物少之又少，她恰为其中之一，极为珍贵，我不愿意这难得的妖物遭遇不测。

8252370.en: All along, Six-Eyed Bright Pupil has sought to uncover the hidden secrets of the world, hoping to understand the laws of the universe.
8252370.ch: 一直以来，六目明瞳都希望探查这八荒背后的隐秘，希望借此了解宇宙之中的规律。

8252371.en: She uses a web-weaving technique to investigate the world's secrets. The information from the ley lines and nether crystals is always accompanied by Nether Air. As she absorbs information through her spider silk network, she inadvertently inhales this Nether Air.
8252371.ch: 她以结网之法查探八荒隐秘，地脉冥晶信息来去都伴随冥气，她接蛛丝网络吸纳地脉信息的同时也不断吸入冥气。

8252372.en: Absorbing Nether Air has dire consequences. At best, she could be consumed by it, losing her mind and becoming the new demon monster king of Chi You. At worst, her body could explode, obliterating her completely.
8252372.ch: 吸纳冥气，轻则被冥气劫持，丧失神智成为赤幽州的新妖王，重则爆体而亡，化为乌有。

8252373.en: In Chi You, cultivators are hunting her, Nether Demons are pursuing her, and even the smallest monsters are attacking her. Now, Six-Eyed Bright Pupil is in dire danger.
8252373.ch: 赤幽州中，修士在追杀她，冥妖也在追杀她，就连小妖小小怪都要对她群起而攻。可以说，六目明瞳处境已万分凶险了。

8252374.en: After cultivating a human form, Six-Eyed Bright Pupil's monster body underwent a dramatic transformation. Not to mention her orb, every part of her body is a supreme treasure in the eyes of cultivators. Since coming to Chi You to investigate the ley lines, she has revealed herself multiple times.
8252374.ch: 六目明瞳修成人身后，妖身即发生剧变，不说内丹，就全身上下都是修士眼中的至宝。她来到赤幽州，为了查探地脉，已多次显露形迹。

8252375.en: Some cultivators, aware of her existence, covet her orb and have attacked her. These individuals from Chi You may appear righteous, but they are far from virtuous.
8252375.ch: 部分修士知道她的存在，觊觎她身上内丹，都出手攻击。这些人平时眼看是赤幽州的正义修士，但暗地里却非善人。

8252376.en: I estimate that Six-Eyed Bright Pupil has constructed a vast network at a critical node of the ley lines, connecting various lines to gather hidden information about the world.
8252376.ch: 依我推测，六目明瞳已在一处地脉关窍中筑起大网，连同各处地脉以收集八荒隐秘信息。

8252377.en: To the Nether Demons, she's an intruder. It's because of this network she's built that the Nether Demons are searching everywhere for her, intent on eliminating this perceived threat.
8252377.ch: 她这一行为在冥妖看来，无异于入侵。因此她才搭起那张大网，冥妖便四处寻找她，要排除这名入侵者。

8252378.en: Although Six-Eyed Bright Pupil is known for her wisdom, her power rivals that of Chi You's monster kings. Ordinary monsters lack discernment, and with two powerful kings in Chi You, they're at a loss. Their only recourse is to continually rally and try to kill Six-Eyed Bright Pupil.
8252378.ch: 六目明瞳虽以睿智见长，但实力绝不亚于赤幽州妖王。一般妖兽并无情志，赤幽州二王并峙，它们无所适从，唯有不断出动，击杀六目明瞳。

8252379.en: Fellow cultivator, I know you've been in contact with Six-Eyed Bright Pupil. I urge you to help me.
8252379.ch: 道友，我知道你一直和六目明瞳有所来往，请你一定要助我。

8252380.en: Xiang Laichi pulls three silk threads from his sleeve. Upon inspection, they are clearly <ta4>'s silk.
8252380.ch: 向来痴从袖中摸出三根丝线，观之正是{name|B}的吐丝。

8252381.en: Fellow cultivator, look. I found these on you. It seems Six-Eyed Bright Pupil has been secretly monitoring you with hidden threads.
8252381.ch: 道友，请看。这些都是我从道友身上探得的。可知六目明瞳早已暗藏丝线监视道友。

8252382.en: Despite her power, she didn't kill you. Instead, she left these threads to keep an eye on you. This suggests an unusual relationship between you two.
8252382.ch: 她作为妖王一般的存在，没有出手将道友杀死，而只是留下丝线暗中留意道友，这说明道友与她交情绝非一般。

8252383.en: Six-Eyed Bright Pupil means no harm to this world. Over time, she has developed a transcendent nature. Her sole desire is to understand the universe's secrets.
8252383.ch: 六目明瞳对这世间绝无恶意，漫长的时光让她养成了出尘脱俗的性格，她希望了解宇宙中的一切隐秘。

8252384.en: There's nothing wrong with her pursuit. She has harmed no one and doesn't deserve such a terrible fate. Fellow cultivator, if you know her whereabouts, please tell me.
8252384.ch: 然而这没有错，她也没有害人，她不应该惨遭横祸。道友若知她踪迹，还请相告。

8252385.en: The cultivator's face clouds with hesitation. He sighs and leaves.
8252385.ch: 这名修士露出难色，他叹了口气，便离开了。

8252386.en: Before you, a small building is surrounded by hordes of monsters. These creatures are growing restless, ready to swarm the structure.
8252386.ch: 面前丝萝小筑为重重妖兽包围，这些妖兽蠢蠢欲动，似乎等待什么契机，便一哄而上，攻陷眼前小筑。

8252387.en: The monsters surrounding the small building sense your hostility. They turn and attack you.
8252387.ch: 丝萝小筑外的妖兽似乎察觉到你的敌意，纷纷朝你攻来。

8252389.en: As soon as <ta4> speaks, a white silk thread wraps around your wrist, pulling you into the building. Simultaneously, flames erupt from the ground, converging on a specific point. A powerful blast erupts from the earth before you, scattering the monsters.
8252389.ch: {name|B}语声才落，一根白丝缠住你手腕将你拉进房屋之中，同时地表燃起火焰，这些火焰似乎被什么牵引，好像点燃引信一般朝某个方位聚拢，当若干火头聚合后，面前地表灵爆炸开，这些妖兽非死即伤纷纷退散。

8252390.en: If you hadn't helped, this move might not have worked.
8252390.ch: 如果不是你来帮了一把，这招还不见得能奏效。

8252391.en: Mortals in Yong Ning might choke to death while eating. We're not mortals and we deal with extraordinary threats. There's nothing to fear.
8252391.ch: 永宁州的凡人保不准吃饭还被噎死了。我们非同凡人，伴随的危险也非一般，这没什么可怕的。

8252392.en: Why should we avoid it? The ley line beneath this building is unique. I've worked hard to find it.
8252392.ch: 为什么要避开？丝萝小筑下方的地脉为我耗费心思寻得，天下独此一处，。

8252393.en: Come with me. We still have a few troublemakers to deal with. You'll be my backup.
8252393.ch: 你随我来，还要解决几个烦人的家伙。你替我掠阵。

8252394.en: Ahead, Nether Demons stagger forward, approaching the small building. Beside you, <ta4>'s eyes gleam coldly as she stares at the distant Nether Demons, waiting for the right moment to strike.
8252394.ch: 前方冥妖踉跄前行，慢慢朝丝萝小筑而去。身边{name|B}眼中放出寒光，死盯远方冥妖，似乎正等待时机，准备出手制敌。

8252395.en: Ah, reckless fools... Crush them... Kill them...

8252397.en: After defeating the Nether Demons, a dark, purplish fog suddenly surrounds <ta4>. She gazes at the distant Nether Demons, then extends a delicate hand, grasping at the void. A surge of strange power erupts, annihilating all the surrounding demons in an instant. <ta4> gives you a chilling glance and vanishes without a trace.
8252397.ch: 你将冥妖击败后，身边{name|B}突然冒出紫黑之气，她目视远方冥妖，然后伸出素手一抓，虚空中无端生出异力，竟将周围冥妖尽数消灭。{name|B}冷漠的看了看你，便闪身离去了。

8252398.en: As you enter the ley lines, you find <ta4> absorbing information from the surrounding ley lines through her silk threads. Several purple streams of power converge upon her, forming a spider web-like network that pulses with dark, billowing vapor.
8252398.ch: 你进入地脉之中，只见{name|B}正从吐丝之中不断吸纳周边地脉信息，几股紫色的力量沿蛛网网络聚集到她身上，使之冒出腾腾黑气。

8252400.en: Should I join the Cultivator Alliance? Or perhaps align myself with the monsters? In this vast world of Chi You, this seems to be the only place I truly belong.
8252400.ch: 那去仙盟？还是去跟那些妖兽为伍？偌大赤幽州，怕只有这里才是我的容身之所吧。

8252401.en: This is the secret of cosmic creation and universal genesis. Your notions of life, death, good, and evil are mere distractions, inconsequential to me. The physical body is but a mote of dust in the universe, hardly worth clinging to.
8252401.ch: 这是天地化生，宇宙生成的大秘密，所谓生死、善恶，都不过是你们修仙者的繁文缛节，我可不不管。身体不过宇宙之中的半点微尘，更是没什么可顾惜的。

8252402.en: What gives you the right? Mind your own affairs.

8252403.en: You've seen what you came for, now leave. I'm not in the mood for company today.
8252403.ch: 那你见过了，这就走吧。今天，我没空招呼你。

8252404.en: As <ta4> speaks, she flashes before you, appearing right beside you in the blink of an eye. With a knowing smile, she gently places her hand on your shoulder.
8252404.ch: {name|B}说着一闪身，已欺到你身边。她得意地笑笑，然后伸手轻轻搭在你肩上，

8252405.en: Ah, I see. You're afraid, aren't you? Afraid that I'll change?
8252405.ch: 哦，我懂了。你怕，怕我不再是我了？

8252406.en: Tell me, then. Who am I?

8252407.en: So, you finally understand, don't you?
8252407.ch: 你今天总算认识我了是吧？

8252408.en: <ta4>'s breath, sweet as orchids, caresses your ear as she speaks, her hand tracing gentle patterns on your shoulder and neck. Suddenly, an overwhelming force lifts you off your feet. When you regain consciousness, you find yourself outside the small building.
8252408.ch: {name|B}吹气如兰，她一边说一边轻轻用手在你肩膀脖子上摩挲。但突然你感觉一股巨力生出，身不由主的凌空飞起，回过神时，已在丝萝小筑之外。

8252409.en: If you're feeling adventurous, perhaps you could help me deal with the Nether Demons and monsters plaguing Chi You. They're a constant nuisance.
8252409.ch: 若有闲暇，不妨帮我清理一下赤幽州的冥妖妖兽，这些杂碎不断骚扰，叫人烦恼不堪。

8252410.en: Have you heard? Another mythical beast has appeared in Chi You. They say it's absolutely terrifying.
8252410.ch: 你知道吗？赤幽州似乎出现了另一只大妖兽，十分骇人。

8252411.en: I know... It used to hunt monsters and Nether Demons, but now it's leading some small monsters in attacks against cultivators.
8252411.ch: 我知道……这妖兽原本击杀妖兽和冥妖，没想到最近竟还率领小妖小怪攻击修仙者。

8252412.en: We should retaliate. We can't let it grow stronger.
8252412.ch: 我觉得咱们应该还以颜色，不能任其坐大。

8252413.en: You have a point. But I've heard some of those cultivators aren't exactly saints themselves.
8252413.ch: 理是这么个理。但我听说那些修士当中也有一些不太正派的。

8252414.en: Ah, Chi You is never truly at peace, is it?
8252414.ch: 唉，这赤幽州总是没得安宁。

8252415.en: <ta4> stands atop the spider web, gazing up at the purple crystal. A mix of resignation and excitement flickers across her face.
8252415.ch: {name|B}站在蛛网上看着高处紫晶，她脸上有一丝无奈，又似带着一丝兴奋。

8252416.en: You've come to judge me, haven't you?

8252417.en: Yes. It was me, so what?

8252418.en: The Nether Demons were interfering with my research. A thousand deaths wouldn't be enough punishment.
8252418.ch: 冥妖碍我查探地脉，罪该万死。

8252419.en: And the minor monsters? They were troublemakers. I just set them straight and showed them who their true master is.
8252419.ch: 这些小妖小怪，近日里昏头转向，不时骚扰，我不过是表明一下立场，让他们知道该去哪找自己的主子罢了。

8252420.en: The truth is, you cultivators started this. You didn't just attack me; you plotted against me. Over a dozen of them planned to take me out in one fell swoop. I had no choice but to fight back. This is a warning to anyone who thinks they can mess with me.
8252420.ch: 事实是，你们修仙者攻击我。他们不但攻击我，还来算计我。他们十多人打算将我一举击杀，我只好还以颜色。好叫后来者不要轻易挑衅。

8252421.en: I just gave them a taste of their own medicine. Earth sank right then and there. I imagine they're all buried six feet under now.
8252421.ch: 我以其人之道，还治其人之身。当时地陷突发，他们如今都埋在土里了吧。

8252422.en: Let me be clear: I don't start fights. But if you come at me, human or monster, I'll cut you down. And if you dare to attack in a pack, watch out—I might just bring down your whole Cultivator Alliance.
8252422.ch: 我话放这，人不犯我，我不犯人。否则人来杀人，妖来斩妖，你们群起来攻的话，当心我把仙盟也掀了。

8252423.en: <ta4> wraps a strand of spider silk around your wrist. She looks wary for a moment, then relaxes and offers a smile.
8252423.ch: {name|B}放出一条蜘蛛丝缠住了你的手腕，她脸上满怀警惕，等了片刻这才舒展了眉头，朝你笑笑。

8252424.en: Sorry, your energy and heartbeat are more honest than your words and expressions.
8252424.ch: 抱歉，你的灵力流动、心跳缓急要比你的表情言语来得诚实一些。

8252425.en: You'd be better off worrying about those arrogant Nether Demons and cultivators.
8252425.ch: 你不如替那些不自量力的冥妖、修仙者担心一下好了。

8252426.en: I'm fascinated by the mysteries of the universe. The rest of it doesn't matter much to me.
8252426.ch: 参透这天地之间的秘密让我觉得十分有趣，至于其他，我并不在意。

8252427.en: The Nether Air is eroding my consciousness. I could lose my mind. As I continue to absorb it, I'll eventually succumb to its corrosive effects.
8252427.ch: 冥气可能会侵蚀我的神志，我可能会失去自身理智，随着不断吸纳冥气，最终我会因为无法抵御冥气的侵蚀而亡。

8252428.ch: 陈述事实，本来就不需要放入太多的情感。

8252429.en: Come with me. I want to show you something.

8252430.en: Nether Demons are closing in on the small building. <ta4> watches them coldly, as if they were mere pawns in her game.
8252430.ch: 前方冥妖游荡，逐渐接近丝萝小筑。{name|B}则在不远处等着，她冷眼看着冥妖，仿佛那只是一具任她掌控拿捏的物事一般。

8252431.en: These Nether Demons are a nuisance. Let's deal with them first.
8252431.ch: 冥妖碍事，先将之铲除再说。

8252432.en: After dispatching the Nether Demons, <ta4> steps to the cliff's edge. The endless mountains and hills of Chi You stretch out before her, a breathtaking panorama.
8252432.ch: 击败冥妖后，{name|B}莲步款款走上前去，立于崖边。目力所及，赤幽州山陵起伏，尽收眼底。

8252433.en: The view here is truly spectacular. Standing here with the wind in our hair, it feels like we're on top of the world. I wonder if even the leader of the Cultivator Alliance could experience anything more majestic.
8252433.ch: 此处景致不错，临风眺望，颇有几分君临天下的味道。我想，即使仙盟之主也不过如此吧？

8252434.en: Very well. I look forward to seeing you surpass even this. When that time comes, you'll have an even broader perspective, overlooking the entire universe.
8252434.ch: 好，期待你有所超越。到时你一定会有更广阔的视野，看着这宇宙的一切吧。

8252435.en: I believe you're capable of even greater things.
8252435.ch: 我想，如果是你的话，一定能有更大的作为吧。

8252436.en: When that day comes, I want to hear it from you—the true magnificence of this universe.
8252436.ch: 若有那么一天，我要你亲口告诉我，这宇宙到底是何等绚丽。

8252437.en: <ta4>'s eyebrows shoot up as she lashes out with spider silk, wrapping it around your neck and pulling you close. Your faces are inches apart, breath mingling. Her eyes pierce yours, as if she could read your mind.
8252437.ch: {name|B}秀眉一轩，蜘蛛丝电闪般勒住你的脖子，将你拖到她的面前。你两面对面的，仅有毫厘之隔，呼吸可闻。而她的眼睛死死盯着你的双眼，似乎在观察你的心意。

8252439.en: <ta4> averts her gaze and offers a small smile. With her spider silk, she adds another knot to your silk knot before returning it to your waist. Then, unexpectedly, the usually aloof woman lets out a soft sigh and turns to leave.
8252439.ch: {name|B}撤开了眼神，微微一笑，然后用蛛丝在你的缠丝百结上又加一结，再替你将之挂回腰间。一向冷傲的她突然幽幽地叹了口气，这才转身离开。

8252440.en: Oh? I'll take your word for it, for now. Let's head back. I'm sure someone of your importance has better things to do.
8252440.ch: 哦？这话我姑且听着。咱们回吧，毕竟你贵人事多。

8252441.en: Then, unexpectedly, the usually aloof woman lets out a soft sigh and turns to leave.
8252441.ch: 一向冷傲的她突然幽幽地叹了口气，这才转身离开。

8252442.en: It doesn't matter. This is the answer I've been looking for, and I don't need anyone else's help. Rest assured, I'll find that answer, no matter the cost.
8252442.ch: 那也无妨，这本来就是我要找的答案，不需旁人帮助。无论如何我都会找到那个答案的。

8252444.en: Fellow cultivator, the underground fires in Chi You are caused by Six-Eyed Bright Pupil's ever-expanding web of spider silk. She's become a serious threat.
8252444.ch: 道友，赤幽州地火，乃是六目明瞳不断扩展蛛丝网络所致。她已经十分危险了。

8252445.en: Six-Eyed Bright Pupil is expanding her spider silk network, tapping into Chi You's ley lines. These lines, sensing the intrusion, are fighting back, causing the underground fires.
8252445.ch: 六目明瞳不断扩展蛛丝网络连接赤幽州各处地脉，地脉察觉有异，立生应激之力，赤幽州地火亦由此而来。

8252446.en: The ley lines, saturated with Nether Air, detect a parasitic presence and intensify their flow of this dark energy. Six-Eyed Bright Pupil, while using her spider silk to gather information, also absorbs this Nether Air. Soon, she'll be overwhelmed by it. Whether she survives this is anyone's guess...
8252446.ch: 地脉饱含冥气，它察觉有异物寄生，便加强了冥气力量的输送。而六目明瞳借蛛丝收集地脉信息，也将冥气一并吸纳了。她很快就会被冥气侵袭，到时她是生是死，那就难说了……

8252447.en: As I predicted, Six-Eyed Bright Pupil is on the brink of collapse. In a desperate bid to survive, she's cocooned herself for protection.
8252447.ch: 如我所料不差，六目明瞳如今已濒临崩溃，她为了维持神识，不得已只能结茧自保。

8252448.en: But even within her cocoon, the Nether Air is seeping in through her spider silk.
8252448.ch: 但即使有茧衣保护，冥气还会通过蛛丝汹涌而入。

8252449.en: Fellow cultivator, you may not trust me. But you can use your own powers to restrain Six-Eyed Bright Pupil, forcing her to stop tapping the ley lines.
8252449.ch: 道友，你或许不信任我。但你可以自行施法困住六目明瞳，让她停止收集地脉信息。

8252450.en: Friend, this Celestial Chart can sever Six-Eyed Bright Pupil's web.
8252450.ch: 道友，这幅天宫寰宇图，能截断六目明瞳的蛛丝网络。

8252451.en: Without her spider silk network, she'll be cut off from the ley lines and stop absorbing Nether Air. Once the Nether Air stops flowing, she should begin to recover.
8252451.ch: 蛛丝网络遭截，六目明瞳无法吸纳地脉信息，自然也不再吸纳冥气。她不吸纳冥气，自然能逐步恢复。

8252452.en: Fellow cultivator, Six-Eyed Bright Pupil is one of this world's beasts. Her fate—life or death—rests in your hands. Choose wisely.
8252452.ch: 道友，六目明瞳乃是天地之间的灵兽。她是生是死，只在你一念之间，还请尽快决断。

8252453.en: The entrance to the ley lines is sealed with spider silk and purple crystals. Through the cracks, you can see spider threads radiating outward. Beneath the crystals, {name|B} is cocooned in layers of spider silk, a massive, pulsing chrysalis.
8252453.ch: 地脉入口已被吐丝以及紫晶封闭，透过缝隙可以看见内里蛛丝向四方辐射开去，地脉紫晶下，{name|B}为蛛丝重重束缚，形似一个大茧。

8252454.en: Suddenly, a rustle fills the air. Countless arachnids swarm towards you from every direction.
8252454.ch: 突然间，周围沙沙声响，无数蜘蛛朝你蜂拥而来。

8252456.en: A faint voice echoes from the cocoon, and nether crystals grow over the entrance, sealing it shut.
8252456.ch: 大茧传来悠悠语声后，缺口长出冥晶瞬间，将里面一切尽数遮蔽……

8252458.en: You unfold the Celestial Palace Universe Map, revealing the talisman placements. Arranged in this pattern, they'll create a powerful force, blocking the Nether Air from invading the ley lines.
8252458.ch: 你展开天宫寰宇图，内里展现布置符咒方位，一旦依此布置，即将生成强大威力，阻隔冥气入侵地脉。

8252459.en: The Celestial Palace Universe Map fails to resonate...
8252459.ch: 天宫寰宇图并未产生共鸣……

8252460.en: Following the map's guidance, you arrange the three talismans. A brilliant golden light erupts, shattering the purple crystals. The entrance is open...
8252460.ch: 你依照天宫寰宇图所示布置三张符咒，四方突然金光大盛，原被遮蔽的入口紫晶纷纷碎裂，洞开一口……

8252461.en: You enter the ley lines and find {name|B} sealed in a silk cocoon. Suddenly, the cocoon rips open, and a slender hand emerges. With a violent tear, the entire cocoon shatters. {name|B} emerges, wreathed in an ominous Nether Air, fixing you with a murderous stare.
8252461.ch: 你进入地脉后，发现丝茧已密封包裹着{name|B}，然而就在此时，丝茧破裂，里面垂下一只纤手，继而哗啦声响大茧四分五裂，{name|B}破茧而出，身上隐隐透出不祥的冥气，死死的盯着你。

8252462.en: Six-Eyed Bright Pupil, corrupted by Nether Air, is no longer one of the beasts! Defeat her, then take her away. I'll maintain the talismans' power. Hurry!
8252462.ch: 六目明瞳遭冥气入侵，已非灵兽，先击败她再将之带走，我为你维持符咒法力，快快动手！

8252463.en: Now or never! Six-Eyed Bright Pupil is rallying her energy. Strike now to save her and shatter the Nether Air's grip! This is our one shot!
8252463.ch: 现在正是机会，六目明瞳正在重聚灵力，乘现在一举将她救出，摆脱冥气控制！成败就此一举！

8252464.en: Oh? I believe you'll come to feel the same way... sooner or later.
8252464.ch: 哦？我倒觉得你迟早也会抱有同感。

8252465.en: Oh? You're more intriguing than I expected.
8252465.ch: 哦？你比我想象得有意思。

8252466.en: Then you'd best be wary of what fate has in store for you.
8252466.ch: 那你可要小心你今后的命运了。

8252467.en: Here's what we'll do. I'll give you the item, and if you don't like it, you can throw it away yourself. Simple as that.
8252467.ch: 这样吧，我把东西给你了，你不喜欢自己扔掉便是。

8252468.en: Just as you hesitate, a flash of fire illuminates the darkness. She has already removed the talisman.
8252468.ch: 你正犹豫，未料眼前火光闪现，她已从自己身上起出符咒。

8252469.en: Ah, I've found the righteous one at last.

8252470.en: Fellow cultivator, hear me out. I can no longer track Six-Eyed Bright Pupil these days. While Six-Eyed Bright Pupil is a powerful being, I mean no harm to her!
8252470.ch: 道友，听我一言，近日我再也追踪不了六目明瞳了。六目明瞳虽是大妖，但我对其并无恶意！

8252471.en: Never have I felt such clarity... The world... the laws of the world, I see them with perfect clarity... I need nothing... else... only the Way of Heaven...
8252471.ch: 我从没试过如此清醒……世界、世界的规则我看得无比清晰……我不需要其他……东西……只求天道……

8252474.en: The cosmos shows no mercy. Even without me, do you truly believe Chi You would find peace?
8252474.ch: 天地不仁，就算没有我，难道赤幽州就会安宁了吗？

8252475.en: You... get out of here, now!

8252478.en: She seems disoriented, clutching her head as violent tremors wrack her body. Her face contorts in agony.
8252478.ch: {name|B}显得很混乱，她抚着头，浑身颤抖，似乎十分痛苦。

8252479.en: Seizing the moment, you grip the silken thread and pull with all your might. The purple crystals binding her body shatter, and she breaks free from the monster, falling into your arms.
8252479.ch: 你乘着当下的良机，手执吐丝使劲一扯，交缠{name|B}身体的紫晶纷纷碎裂，她豁的离开了妖兽本体，摔入你的怀中。

8252480.en: She gives you a faint smile before falling unconscious in your arms...
8252480.ch: {name|B}看着你微微一笑，便即昏倒在你怀中……

8252481.en: Six-Eyed Bright Pupil won't wake for some time. Let's lay her to rest in the Silken Cottage for now. As one of the sacred beasts of this world, she is no ordinary being, but even she needs time to heal herself. Let her rest. By the way, she... she smiled at you. I can't believe she actually smiled at you...
8252481.ch: 六目明瞳这下一时半会无法醒来，我们暂时将她安放在丝萝小筑之中便是。她作为天地之间的灵兽，非同小可，但也需要时间自行疗愈，我们让她休息一下吧。她……对你笑了，竟然对你笑了……

8252482.en: You... you killed her? Damn you! Didn't I tell you? That was our chance to save her! Damn you to hell!
8252482.ch: 你……竟将她杀了？可恶！我不是说了吗？当时正是机会可将她一举救出！可恶！
